### 600. pants. Notice of enforcement against immovable property

(1)	If the creditor requests enforcement against immovable property, the bailiff sends a notice to the debtor and invites him to settle the debt, as well as to provide information on whether the debtor is registered as a value added tax payer and whether, when selling his immovable property at auction, the auction price is subject to value added tax and what is the taxable value of this price.

(2)	The bailiff submits to the district (city) court a request for confirmation to enter an enforcement note. The consequences of this note are specified in the first part of Article 1077, Articles 1081 and 1305 of the Civil Law, as well as in Article 46 of the Land Register Law.

(3)	The bailiff, in accordance with the extract of the relevant land register section, sends a notice to the owner of the immovable property, holders of building rights, co-owners of the immovable property, except for co-owners of a residential house that has not been divided into apartment properties, as well as to all mortgage creditors, including persons in whose favour a pledge right or prohibition note has been entered, indicating:

1)	for the satisfaction of which person's claim enforcement is being directed against the immovable property;

2)	how large the debt amount is and whether the debt is secured by a mortgage on the relevant immovable property.

(4)	In the notice referred to in the third part of this Article, the bailiff requests that the mortgage creditors submit information on the amount of the remaining mortgage debt within the time limit set by the bailiff, which shall not be less than 10 days.

(5)	The bailiff requests from the local government information on the immovable property tax debt and invites the local government to submit a decision on the recovery of the tax debt, if such exists.

(6)	If the debtor has fully paid the debt and the costs of enforcement of the judgment to the bailiff no later than seven days before the auction closing date indicated in the auction announcement, the sale of the immovable property shall be cancelled and the auction already commenced shall be terminated.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 19.06.2003., 05.02.2009., 20.12.2010., 08.09.2011. 23.05.2013.,
11.09.2014., 28.05.2015., 01.03.2018., 25.10.2018. and 11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 601. pants. Debtor's obligations

(1)	From the date of receipt of the bailiff's notice, the debtor is prohibited from:

1)	alienating this immovable property or pledging it;

2)	felling timber therein, except that necessary for maintaining the household;

3)	alienating or damaging the accessories of the immovable property;

4)	transferring this immovable property into possession of another person, including concluding lease, rent and other contracts encumbering the immovable property.

(2)	Contracts which the debtor has concluded regarding the immovable property after an enforcement note has been made in the land register are not valid in relation to the creditor and the purchaser of the immovable property at auction.

(3)	The validity of contracts which the debtor has concluded regarding the immovable property before an enforcement note has been entered in the land register shall be determined both in relation to the parties that participated in these contracts and in relation to the purchaser of the immovable property at auction, in accordance with the Civil Law.

(4)	The debtor has an obligation to notify within the time limit set by the bailiff of the actual possessor and manager of the immovable property, if such exists, as well as of all lease, rent and other contracts encumbering the immovable property concluded in relation to this immovable property, submitting copies of the said contracts while simultaneously presenting their originals.

(5)	The debtor has an obligation to notify the bailiff whether he is registered as a value added tax payer and whether, when selling his immovable property at auction, the auction price is subject to value added tax. If the auction price is subject to value added tax in accordance with the regulatory enactments regulating value added tax, in the said information the debtor indicates the taxable value of this price.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 20.12.2010., 08.09.2011. and 23.05.2013., which
enters into force on 01.11.2013.)

### 602. pants. Rights of creditors and other creditors

(1)	The creditor, regardless of enforcement against the immovable property, has the right to request that a mortgage be confirmed for him in the land register in the amount of the sum to be recovered.

(2)	The mortgage creditor has the right to participate in the description of the immovable property, to receive the description act and to publish announcements about the auction at his own expense, notifying the bailiff thereof.

(3)	The mortgage creditor and the creditor have the right to participate in the bidding by paying the security specified in the first part of Article 607 of this Law.

(4)	The creditor, by submitting an application to the bailiff, may request to postpone the auction or to issue an enforcement document according to which enforcement has not been made or has been made incompletely, if such request of the creditor is received no later than seven days before the auction closing date indicated in the auction announcement.

(5)	A mortgage creditor to whom sanctions apply may not exercise the rights granted to him in this and other Articles of this Law, insofar as these rights are not compatible with the restrictions imposed by the sanctions. The aforementioned does not constitute an obstacle to the performance of official duties in the enforcement case.
(With amendments made by the laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 04.02.2016. and 11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 603. pants. Description of immovable property

(1)	The bailiff describes the immovable property at the request of the creditor. He notifies the debtor of the time of description of the immovable property by sending the notice provided for in Article 600 of this Law, and the creditor. At the description of the immovable property, the debtor and the creditor have the right to invite no more than two witnesses. The non-appearance of the debtor, creditor or witnesses does not suspend the description.

(2)	The description act indicates:

1)	the name, surname, place of office and place of practice of the bailiff;

2)	the decision of the court or other institution which is being executed;

3)	the name and surname of the creditor and the debtor or their authorised persons or representatives, if such participate in the description;

4)	the name, surname, declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration of witnesses, but if there are none, — the place of residence, if such participate in the description;

5)	the place where the immovable property is located;

6)	of which parts the immovable property consists;

7)	on the basis of the land register entry:

a)	the value of the immovable property being described, if such is indicated, its owner, encumbrances with debts and their amounts, as well as restrictions and encumbrances imposed on the immovable property,

b)	information on the condition of the immovable property and contracts concluded in relation to this property, if the bailiff is aware of such, as well as information on movable property which is an accessory of the immovable property;

8)	the actual possessor or manager of the immovable property, if such are known.

(3)	When describing a technologically interconnected set of equipment and buildings, it also indicates in which buildings it is located, the size of the buildings occupied, the composition, the number of work premises, the number of workshops and other equipment.

(4)	When describing immovable property, the provisions of Articles 576 and 577 of this Law also apply.

(5)	The debtor submits documents and plans by which the area of the immovable property being described and the debtor's rights to this property are determined, as well as notifies the bailiff who is the actual possessor and manager of the immovable property.

(6)	The bailiff, at the request of interested persons and at their expense, may request from the district (city) court those documents which relate to the immovable property being described.

(7)	The non-receipt of the documents specified in the fifth and sixth parts of this Article does not suspend the description.

(8)	If the debtor or creditor has not participated in the description of the immovable property, the bailiff sends the description act to them within three days after the description.
(In the wording of the law of 31.10.2002. with amendments made by the laws of 29.11.2012., 25.10.2018. and 11.11.2021., which enter into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 604. pants. Nekustamā īpašuma novērtēšana

(1)	Nekustamo īpašumu uz parādnieka rēķina pēc tiesu izpildītāja pieprasījuma novērtē sertificēts nekustamā īpašuma vērtētājs, nosakot nekustamā īpašuma piespiedu pārdošanas vērtību.  

(2)	Tiesu izpildītājs paziņo par novērtējumu parādniekam, piedzinējam un hipotekārajam kreditoram, vienlaikus izskaidrojot viņu tiesības 10 dienu laikā no paziņojuma nosūtīšanas dienas lūgt nekustamā īpašuma atkārtotu novērtēšanu.  

(3)	Persona, kura lūgusi atkārtotu novērtēšanu, sedz novērtēšanas izdevumus tiesu izpildītāja noteiktajā termiņā, iemaksājot nepieciešamo naudas summu tiesu izpildītāja kontā. Ja novērtēšanai nepieciešamā naudas summa šajā termiņā nav iemaksāta, tiesu izpildītājs lūgumu par nekustamā īpašuma atkārtotu novērtēšanu noraida.  
(05.02.2009. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

### 605. pants. Nekustamā īpašuma pārvaldīšana

(1)	Aprakstītais nekustamais īpašums līdz nodošanai jaunajam īpašniekam paliek agrākā valdītāja vai pārvaldnieka pārvaldīšanā.  

(2)	Īpašuma valdītājs vai pārvaldnieks aprakstīto nekustamo īpašumu saglabā tādā pašā stāvoklī, kāds tas bija aprakstes brīdī, un kopā ar to pašu kustamo mantu.  

(3)	Ja nav zināms nekustamā īpašuma valdītājs vai pārvaldnieks, tiesu izpildītājs pēc saviem ieskatiem var iecelt nekustamā īpašuma pārvaldnieku. Tiesu izpildītāja ieceltajam nekustamā īpašuma pārvaldītājam ir tāda pati atbildība kā šajā likumā noteiktajam kustamās mantas glabātājam.  

(4)	Nekustamā īpašuma valdītājam un pārvaldniekam jādod norēķins tiesu izpildītājam par aprakstītā īpašuma pārvaldīšanas laiku. Saņemtie ienākumi no nekustamā īpašuma nododami tiesu izpildītājam un pievienojami summai, kas ieņemta, šo īpašumu pārdodot.  
(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2003.)

605.1 pants. Elektronisko izsoļu vietne

(1)	Elektronisko izsoļu vietne ir Izpildu lietu reģistra modulis, kas nodrošina izsoles sludinājumu izvietošanu, izsoles dalībnieku reģistrāciju, informācijas uzkrāšanu par reģistrētajiem izsoles dalībniekiem, reģistrēto izsoles dalībnieku autorizāciju dalībai izsludinātajā izsolē, kā arī tehnoloģisko rīku kopu solījumu izdarīšanai un reģistrēšanai.  

(2)	Tiesu izpildītājs, pildot amata pienākumus, elektronisko izsoļu vietnē izvieto izsoles sludinājumus, reģistrē izsoļu dalībniekus, autorizē viņus dalībai izsludinātajā izsolē, kā arī veic citas darbības, kas saistītas ar izsoles rīkošanu.  

(3)	Kārtību, kādā veic darbības elektronisko izsoļu vietnē, nosaka Ministru kabinets.  
(28.05.2015. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 02.07.2015. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 106.punktu)

605.2 pants. Izsoļu dalībnieku reģistrs

(1)	Elektronisko izsoļu vietnes izsoļu dalībnieku reģistrs satur ziņas par personām, kas piekritušas elektronisko izsoļu vietnes lietošanas noteikumiem un reģistrētas kā izsoļu dalībnieki. Izsoļu dalībnieku reģistrā iekļautajām personām ir pienākums paziņot par izmaiņām to datos. Izsoļu dalībnieku reģistrā iekļautā informācija ir ierobežotas pieejamības informācija.  

(2)	Ministru kabinets nosaka kārtību, kādā ziņas par personu tiek iekļautas izsoļu dalībnieku reģistrā, iekļaujamo ziņu apjomu, kā arī šo ziņu aktualizēšanas un dzēšanas kārtību.  
(28.05.2015. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 02.07.2015. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 106.punktu)

### 606.pants. Nekustamā īpašuma izsoles izziņošana

(1)	Tiesu izpildītājs izziņo nekustamā īpašuma izsoli, ja šā likuma 604.pantā noteiktajā termiņā nav iesniegts lūgums par nekustamā īpašuma jaunu novērtēšanu vai tas ir noraidīts.  

(2)	Sludinājumu par nekustamā īpašuma izsoli tiesu izpildītājs nosūta publicēšanai oficiālajā izdevumā "Latvijas Vēstnesis" un ievieto elektronisko izsoļu vietnē.  

(3)	Sludinājumā par nekustamā īpašuma izsoli norāda:

1)	nekustamā īpašuma īpašnieka un piedzinēja vārdu un uzvārdu, juridiskajām personām — nosaukumu un juridisko adresi;  

2)	tiesu izpildītāja vārdu, uzvārdu, amata vietu un prakses vietu;  

3)	nekustamā īpašuma īsu aprakstu, atrašanās vietu un kadastra numuru;  

31) apbūves tiesības līguma datumu, priekšmetu un termiņu, ja tiek izsolīta apbūves tiesība;  

4)	nekustamā īpašuma novērtējumu;  

5)	kura izsole pēc kārtas tā ir;  

6)	izsoles sākumcenu un izsoles soli;  

7)	izsoles sākuma datumu un noslēguma datumu un laiku;  

8)	vai izsoles cena apliekama ar pievienotās vērtības nodokli un kāda ir šīs cenas apliekamā vērtība;  

9)	nodrošinājuma summu, kas iemaksājama tiesu izpildītāja depozīta kontā;  

10)	datumu, līdz kuram persona, kas vēlas piedalīties izsolē, var iemaksāt nodrošinājuma summu un lūgt tiesu izpildītāju autorizēt to dalībai izsolē;  

11)	norādi uz tīmekļa vietni, kur pieejama informācija par izsoles kārtību un nosacījumiem, ar kādiem personas var reģistrēties dalībai izsolē un piedalīties solīšanā.  

(4)	Sludinājumā norādītais izsoles sākuma datums nedrīkst būt vēlāks par 10 darba dienām, skaitot no datuma, kurā sludinājums nosūtīts publicēšanai oficiālajā izdevumā "Latvijas Vēstnesis".  

(5)	Vienlaikus ar nekustamā īpašuma izsoles sludinājuma nosūtīšanu publicēšanai oficiālajā izdevumā "Latvijas Vēstnesis" tiesu izpildītājs paziņo par izsoli parādniekam un piedzinējam, nekustamā īpašuma īpašniekam, apbūves tiesīgajiem, kopīpašniekiem, izņemot tādas dzīvojamās mājas kopīpašniekiem, kura nav sadalīta dzīvokļu īpašumos, hipotekārajiem kreditoriem un personām, kuru labā ierakstītas ķīlas tiesības vai aizlieguma atzīme. Paziņojumā

norāda arī to, vai izsoles cena apliekama ar pievienotās vērtības nodokli un kāda ir šīs cenas apliekamā vērtība.  

(6)	Tiesu izpildītājs nosaka izsoles soli, ne mazāku par vienu procentu un ne lielāku par 10 procentiem no nekustamā īpašuma izsoles sākumcenas.  

(7)	No izsoles izsludināšanas dienas visi dokumenti, kas attiecas uz nekustamā īpašuma pārdošanu izsolē, ir pieejami visām personām, kuras vēlas ar tiem iepazīties.  

(8)	Dalībnieki, kas autorizēti izsolei, drīkst izdarīt solījumus visā izsoles norises laikā.

### 604. Section. Valuation of immovable property

(1) Immovable property shall be valued at the debtor's expense upon the request of a bailiff by a certified immovable property appraiser, determining the forced sale value of the immovable property.

(2) The bailiff shall notify the debtor, the creditor and the mortgage creditor of the valuation, at the same time explaining their right to request a re-valuation of the immovable property within 10 days from the date of sending the notification.

(3) The person who has requested a re-valuation shall cover the valuation expenses within the time limit set by the bailiff by depositing the necessary amount of money into the bailiff's account. If the amount of money necessary for the valuation has not been deposited within this time limit, the bailiff shall reject the request for re-valuation of the immovable property.
(In the wording of the law of 05.02.2009. with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 605. Section. Management of immovable property

(1) The described immovable property shall remain under the management of the previous possessor or manager until transfer to the new owner.

(2) The possessor or manager of the property shall preserve the described immovable property in the same condition as it was at the time of description, and together with the same movable property.

(3) If the possessor or manager of the immovable property is not known, the bailiff may, at his or her discretion, appoint a manager of the immovable property. The manager of the immovable property appointed by the bailiff shall have the same liability as the custodian of movable property provided for in this law.

(4) The possessor and manager of the immovable property shall give an account to the bailiff for the period of management of the described property. The income received from the immovable property shall be handed over to the bailiff and added to the sum obtained from selling this property.
(In the wording of the law of 31.10.2002., which enters into force on 01.01.2003.)

605.1 Section. Electronic auction website

(1) The electronic auction website is a module of the Register of Enforcement Matters that ensures the placement of auction announcements, registration of auction participants, accumulation of information about registered auction participants, authorisation of registered auction participants to participate in the announced auction, as well as a set of technological tools for making and registering bids.

(2) The bailiff, in performing official duties, places auction announcements on the electronic auction website, registers auction participants, authorises them to participate in the announced auction, as well as performs other actions related to organising the auction.

(3) The procedure by which actions are performed on the electronic auction website shall be determined by the Cabinet of Ministers.
(In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015., which enters into force on 02.07.2015. See transitional provision 106.)

605.2 Section. Register of auction participants

(1) The register of auction participants of the electronic auction website contains information about persons who have agreed to the terms of use of the electronic auction website and are registered as auction participants. Persons included in the register of auction participants have an obligation to notify of changes in their data. The information included in the register of auction participants is information of restricted access.

(2) The Cabinet of Ministers shall determine the procedure by which information about a person is included in the register of auction participants, the scope of information to be included, as well as the procedure for updating and deleting this information.
(In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015., which enters into force on 02.07.2015. See transitional provision 106.)

### 606. Section. Announcement of auction of immovable property

(1) The bailiff shall announce the auction of immovable property if, within the time limit provided for in Section 604 of this law, a request for a new valuation of the immovable property has not been submitted or it has been rejected.

(2) The bailiff shall send the announcement of the auction of immovable property for publication in the official publication "Latvijas Vēstnesis" and place it on the electronic auction website.

(3) The announcement of the auction of immovable property shall indicate:

1) the name and surname of the owner of the immovable property and the creditor, for legal persons — the name and legal address;

2) the name, surname, place of office and place of practice of the bailiff;

3) a brief description of the immovable property, its location and cadastral number;

31) the date, subject and term of the building rights agreement, if the building right is being auctioned;

4) the valuation of the immovable property;

5) which auction in order it is;

6) the starting price of the auction and the auction step;

7) the start date and closing date and time of the auction;

8) whether the auction price is subject to value added tax and what is the taxable value of this price;

9) the security amount to be deposited into the bailiff's deposit account;

10) the date by which a person wishing to participate in the auction may deposit the security amount and request the bailiff to authorise it to participate in the auction;

11) a reference to the website where information is available about the auction procedure and conditions under which persons may register to participate in the auction and participate in bidding.

(4) The auction start date indicated in the announcement shall not be later than 10 working days, counting from the date on which the announcement was sent for publication in the official publication "Latvijas Vēstnesis".

(5) Simultaneously with sending the announcement of the auction of immovable property for publication in the official publication "Latvijas Vēstnesis", the bailiff shall notify the debtor and the creditor, the owner of the immovable property, building rights holders, co-owners, except for co-owners of a residential house that has not been divided into apartment properties, mortgage creditors and persons in whose favour pledge rights or a prohibition note are registered. The notification shall also indicate whether the auction price is subject to value added tax and what is the taxable value of this price.

(6) The bailiff shall determine the auction step, not less than one percent and not more than 10 percent of the starting price of the auction of the immovable property.

(7) From the date of announcement of the auction, all documents relating to the sale of the immovable property at auction shall be available to all persons who wish to familiarise themselves with them.

(8) Participants who are authorised for the auction may make bids throughout the entire course of the auction.
(In the wording of the law of 28.05.2015. with amendments made by the laws of 01.03.2018. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 607.pants

Nekustamā īpašuma pirkuma nodrošinājums un izsoles dalībnieku autorizācija

### 607.pants

Security for real estate purchase and authorization of auction participants

(1)	A person who wishes to participate in a real estate auction shall, within 20 days from the auction start date indicated in the real estate auction notice, deposit security in the amount of 10 percent of the real estate valuation into the bailiff's deposit account indicated in the auction notice and, using the electronic auction website, send a request to the bailiff to authorize them to participate in the auction.

(2)	The bailiff shall authorize a person to participate in the auction within five working days from the date of receipt of the security and the person's request, if the restrictions mentioned in paragraph three of this Section do not exist. If the security or authorization request is not received within the time limit specified in paragraph one of this Section or the person does not have the right to participate in the auction in accordance with paragraph three of this Section, the bailiff shall refuse to authorize the person to participate in the auction.

(3)	The debtor, except for an auction held for the execution of a court judgment on the division of joint property, their guardian or trustee, the person who performed the valuation referred to in Section 604 of this Law, as well as the bailiff conducting the auction, shall not have the right to participate in the auction. The auction participants themselves are responsible for compliance with the restrictions established in other regulatory enactments regarding the acquisition of real estate.

(4)	The security deposited by the person who has purchased the real estate at auction shall be credited towards the purchase price. The security deposited by the other auction participants shall be returned to them immediately after the conclusion of the auction. The security deposited by the last outbid bidder shall be returned within two working days after the successful bidder has paid the full amount bid. If the real estate is retained by the last outbid bidder after an unsuccessful auction, their deposited security shall be credited towards the purchase price.
(28.05.2015. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 04.02.2016., 25.10.2018. un 16.06.2022. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 07.07.2022.)

607. 1 pants. Starting price of auction

The auction shall start from the forced sale value indicated in the real estate valuation. If there have been two valuations, the auction shall start from the highest real estate valuation amount.
(05.02.2009. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.03.2009.)

### 608. pants. Procedure for real estate auction

(1)	An auction participant may make bids electronically from the moment they are authorized to participate in the auction in the manner prescribed in Section 607 of this Law until the moment the auction has concluded.

(2)	Bidding shall start from the starting price of the auction. A bidder may not register a bid that is less than or equal to the starting price of the auction, differs from the auction step specified in the auction notice, or is less than or equal to previously registered bids. Registered bids may not be withdrawn or changed.

(3)	On the electronic auction website, bids shall be registered in chronological order, recording the amount bid and the time of registration of the bid. During the course of the auction, this information shall be available to the bailiff and auction participants. During the course of the auction and after the conclusion of the auction, information about the highest price bid shall be publicly available on the electronic auction website.

(4)	The auction shall conclude on the thirtieth day from the auction start date indicated in the real estate auction notice at 13.00, but if the thirtieth day falls on a day off or a public holiday — on the next working day until 13.00. If a bid is registered during the last five minutes before the time set for the conclusion of the auction, the auction

time shall be automatically extended by five minutes. If significant technical disruptions that may affect the auction result are detected during the last hour before the conclusion of the auction and they are not related to system security breaches, the auction time shall be automatically extended until 13.00 on the next working day. After the conclusion of the auction, bids shall no longer be registered and the electronic auction website shall indicate the date and time of the conclusion of the auction and the last bid made.

(5)	The bailiff may suspend a real estate auction in the cases provided for in this Law. A notice of suspension of the auction shall be published on the electronic auction website.

(6)	After the conclusion of the auction, a notice shall be sent electronically to the successful bidder to the electronic auction website user account registered in the Auction Participants Register that they have bid a higher price than others and the obligation to pay the entire amount due from them has arisen (Section 611, paragraph two).
(28.05.2015. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 04.02.2016. un 01.03.2018. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.07.2018.)

### 609. pants. Double auction

(1)	A double auction may be requested by a mortgage creditor if, after the registration of the mortgage in the Land Register, an encumbrance on the real estate has been registered without their consent that may affect the amount of satisfaction of the mortgage creditor, and the auction is held for the collection of a claim by them or by a mortgage creditor registered in the Land Register earlier than them.

(2)	The real estate shall be sold at auction on the condition that the said encumbrance is to be retained, and on the condition that the said encumbrance is to be deleted.

(3)	If no one wishes to acquire the real estate with the retained encumbrance, it shall remain with the successful bidder on the condition that the encumbrance is deleted.

(4)	If there are bidders who wish to purchase the real estate both retaining the encumbrance and deleting it, the real estate shall remain with the successful bidder on the condition of deleting the encumbrance only if the price bid exceeds not only the highest price bid on the condition of retaining the encumbrance, but also the amount of claims that have priority compared to the claims of the mortgage creditor who requested the double auction.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2003.)

### 610. pants. Auction record

(1)	In the auction record, the bailiff shall indicate:

1)	the date and time of the start and conclusion of the auction;

2)	the first name, surname, place of office and place of practice of the bailiff;

3)	the decision being executed;

4)	what real estate is being auctioned and the starting price of the auction;

5)	the persons authorized to participate in the auction, indicating their first name, surname, personal identity number or date of birth (for a person who has not been assigned a personal identity number), the contact address indicated in the Auction Participants Register; for a legal person — its name, registration number and legal address;

6)	the prices bid at the auction and the first name and surname or firm (name) of the bidder;

7)	the highest price bid, the first name and surname or name of the successful bidder, personal identity number or registration number and address;

8)	encumbrances, if the real estate is sold on the condition that they are to be retained.

(2)	An auction record prepared electronically on the electronic auction website shall be valid without the signature of the bailiff.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 28.05.2015. un 01.03.2018. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.07.2018.)

(8)	Apmierinot pieteikumu par izsoles akta apstiprināšanu un nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz ieguvēja vārda gadījumos, kad pirkuma summas samaksai izmantota kredītiestādes pieprasījuma garantijas vēstule, tiesa uz kredītiestādes lūguma pamata vienlaikus ar nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz ieguvēja vārda nostiprina arī hipotēku par labu kredītiestādei, kas izsniegusi attiecīgo garantiju.  

(9)	Lēmumu, ar kuru apstiprināts izsoles akts vai apmierināts pieteikums par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz nosolītāja, kopīpašnieka vai kreditora vārda (615. panta piektā daļa), tiesa sastāda rezolūcijas veidā, izņemot gadījumu, kad lietā iesniegta sūdzība par izsoles atzīšanu par spēkā neesošu.  

(10)	Par tiesas lēmumu var iesniegt blakus sūdzību apgabaltiesā.  

(11)	Pēc tam, kad stājies spēkā tiesas lēmums, ar kuru apmierināts pieteikums par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz ieguvēja vārda, tiesu izpildītājs šā likuma 611.panta otrās daļas 4.punktā vai 615.panta ceturtās daļas 2.punktā minēto valsts un kancelejas nodevu, kāda normatīvajos aktos noteikta īpašuma tiesību nostiprināšanai zemesgrāmatā, iemaksā valsts budžetā un paziņo par to ieguvējam un attiecīgajai rajona (pilsētas) tiesai.  

(12)	Šajā pantā noteiktajā kārtībā, ciktāl tā attiecas uz lēmuma par izsoles akta apstiprināšanu pieņemšanu, rajona (pilsētas) tiesa apstiprina arī kuģa izsoles aktu.  
(11.09.2014. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 01.06.2017., 25.10.2018., 25.03.2021. un 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

### 611. Section. Consequences of the auction

(1)	The immovable property remains with the person who has offered a higher price than others.

(2)	Within one month from the date of the conclusion of the auction, the successful bidder must pay:

1)	the entire sum which he or she has bid;

2)	value added tax, if the auction price is subject to value added tax;

3)	the state fee specified in Paragraph 15 of Part One of Section 34 of this Law for an application for registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer;

4)	the state and registry fee as specified in regulatory enactments for the registration of property rights in the Land Register.

(21) Payment of the entire sum shall also be deemed to include a letter of guarantee on demand from a credit institution submitted to the bailiff, which specifies the subject of the guarantee, the amount and the term, which may not be shorter than three months from the date of confirmation of the auction deed, if the creditor and the mortgagee have consented to the use of such a letter of guarantee on demand. The bailiff shall accept a letter of guarantee on demand from a credit institution for payment if it is accompanied by a request from the credit institution for the establishment of a pledge right on the immovable property sold and a pledge agreement between the credit institution and the successful bidder for the pledging of the immovable property bid, as well as a payment made to the bailiff's deposit account for payment of the state fee for registration of the pledge right in the Land Register. In such a case, the bailiff shall indicate in the application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer that, on the basis of the request from the credit institution attached to the application, simultaneously with the registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer, a mortgage shall also be registered in favour of the credit institution which has issued the relevant guarantee.

(3)	After the successful bidder of the immovable property has paid the entire sum due from him or her, the bailiff shall submit the application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer electronically to the district (city) court, using the Court Information System, and request that the property rights be registered in the Land Register in the name of the acquirer.

(31)	After the bailiff submits to the credit institution the court decision on confirmation of the auction deed, the credit institution shall, within three days, transfer to the bailiff's deposit account the sum specified in the letter of guarantee on demand from the credit institution.

(32)	After the time limit for appealing the calculation prepared by the bailiff has expired and this calculation has not been appealed, or, if this calculation has been appealed, after the court decision on the prepared calculation has entered into force, the bailiff shall pay the value added tax paid by the successful bidder into the state budget and notify the debtor and the State Revenue Service thereof.

(4)	If the successful bidder does not pay the entire sum due from him or her within the specified time limit, the security paid shall be added to the total sum received for the property and distributed in the same manner as this sum. The security paid shall also be added to the total sum if it is established that the successful bidder did not have the right to participate in the auction (Part Three of Section 607), as well as if the last outbidding bidder has not notified of retaining the immovable property for himself or herself for his or her highest bid price or has refused to retain it for himself or herself (Part Two of Section 615).
(With amendments made by the Laws of 31.10.2002., 05.02.2009., 17.12.2009., 20.12.2010., 12.09.2013., 11.09.2014.,
28.05.2015., 01.06.2017., 01.03.2018., 25.10.2018., 25.03.2021.	and 11.11.2021.,  which  enter  into  force
01.12.2021.)

### 612. Section. Set-off of the purchase price

(1)	The successful bidder is permitted to set off against the purchase sum his or her mortgage claim, which is substantiated by an enforcement document, as well as other mortgage debts, if the mortgagees consent to leaving them on the immovable property, transferring these debts to the successful bidder.

(2)	If the sum received from the sale is insufficient to satisfy all claims and mortgage debts, the successful bidder may set off his or her claims against the purchase price only to the extent of the sum which, according to the calculation, is due to him or her after those claims which have priority over his or her claim have been satisfied.
(With amendments made by the Law of 05.02.2009., which enters into force 01.03.2009.)

### 613. Section. Confirmation of the auction deed of immovable property

(1)	The court shall examine the case concerning the registration of immovable property in the name of the acquirer (person who has taken over the immovable property, or successful bidder) in written proceedings within 30 days from the submission of the bailiff's application to the court. The court shall notify the bailiff, as well as the creditor, the debtor, the acquirer of the immovable property, the owner of the immovable property, the mortgagee and the person who has submitted the complaint referred to in Part Two of Section 617 of this Law, if such a complaint has been submitted, of the examination of the case.

(2)	The bailiff shall include in the application information on the enforcement actions taken in the case in connection with the enforcement on the immovable property, and certify the payment of the court costs specified in Paragraphs 3 and 4 of Part Two of Section 611 of this Law for the submission of the said application to the court.

(3)	When examining the case, the court shall review the data in the Enforcement Case Register. The court is entitled to request additional written explanations and evidence from the persons involved in the case in order to clarify the circumstances and evidence of the case.

(4)	Simultaneously with the application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer, the court may also examine a complaint about the bailiff's actions if the complainant requests that the auction be declared invalid (Part Two of Section 617).

(5)	Upon granting the application, the court shall adopt a decision:

1)	on confirmation of the auction deed and registration of the immovable property sold in the name of the acquirer;

2)	irrespective of the creditor's consent, on the deletion of all debt obligations registered in the Land Register on this property, which the acquirer has not expressly declared that he or she assumes;

3)	irrespective of the creditor's consent, on the deletion of those encumbrances which have been accepted as a condition upon acquiring the property (Section 609);

4)	on the deletion of prohibition notes registered in the Land Register on this property;

5)	on the rejection of the complaint about declaring the auction invalid, if such a complaint has been submitted.

(6)	Upon rejecting the application, the court shall declare the auction invalid.

(7)	(Deleted by the Law of 11.11.2021.)

(8)	Upon granting the application for confirmation of the auction deed and registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer in cases where a letter of guarantee on demand from a credit institution has been used for payment of the purchase sum, the court, on the basis of the request of the credit institution, shall, simultaneously with the registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer, also register a mortgage in favour of the credit institution which has issued the relevant guarantee.

(9)	The decision by which the auction deed has been confirmed or the application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the successful bidder, co-owner or creditor has been granted (Part Five of Section 615) shall be prepared by the court in the form of a resolution, except in cases where a complaint about declaring the auction invalid has been submitted in the case.

(10)	An appeal may be submitted to the regional court against the court decision.

(11)	After the court decision by which the application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer has been granted has entered into force, the bailiff shall pay the state and registry fee referred to in Paragraph 4 of Part Two of Section 611 or Paragraph 2 of Part Four of Section 615 of this Law, as specified in regulatory enactments for the registration of property rights in the Land Register, into the state budget and notify the acquirer and the relevant district (city) court thereof.

(12)	In the procedure specified in this Section, insofar as it relates to the adoption of a decision on confirmation of the auction deed, the district (city) court shall also confirm the auction deed of a vessel.
(In the wording of the Law of 11.09.2014. with amendments made by the Laws of 01.06.2017., 25.10.2018., 25.03.2021. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force 01.12.2021.)

### 614. pants. Nenotikusi izsole

(1)	Tiesu izpildītājs izsoli atzīst par nenotikušu, ja:

1)	izsolei nav autorizēts neviens izsoles dalībnieks;  

2)	neviens no dalībniekiem, kas autorizēti izsolei, nepārsola sākumcenu;  

3)	nosolītājs noteiktā termiņā nesamaksā visu summu, kas no viņa pienākas (611.panta otrā daļa);  

4)	izsoles norises laikā, izņemot šā likuma 608.panta ceturtajā daļā minēto gadījumu, vai 24 stundu laikā pēc izsoles noslēguma saņemts elektronisko izsoļu vietnes drošības pārvaldnieka paziņojums par būtiskiem tehniskiem traucējumiem, kas var ietekmēt izsoles rezultātu.  

(2)	Par to, ka izsole uzskatāma par nenotikušu šā panta pirmās daļas 1. vai 2.punktā minētajos gadījumos, tiesu izpildītājs sastāda aktu un paziņo parādniekam un nekustamā īpašuma īpašniekam. Dalībniekiem, kas autorizēti dalībai izsolē, paziņojumu nosūta, izmantojot elektronisko izsoļu vietni.  

(3)	Par to, ka izsole uzskatāma par nenotikušu šā panta pirmās daļas 3.punktā minētajā gadījumā, tiesu izpildītājs sastāda aktu un paziņo nosolītājam, parādniekam un nekustamā īpašuma īpašniekam.  

(4)	Saņēmis šā panta pirmās daļas 4.punktā minēto paziņojumu, tiesu izpildītājs pārtrauc izsoli un izsoles norises laikā ievieto par to paziņojumu elektronisko izsoļu vietnē.  

(5)	Par to, ka izsole uzskatāma par nenotikušu šā panta pirmās daļas 4.punktā minētajā gadījumā, tiesu izpildītājs sastāda aktu un paziņo piedzinējam, parādniekam un nekustamā īpašuma īpašniekam. Dalībniekiem, kas autorizēti dalībai izsolē, paziņojumu nosūta, izmantojot elektronisko izsoļu vietni.  
(28.05.2015. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 04.02.2016. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 29.02.2016.)

### 615. pants. Nenotikušas izsoles sekas

(1)	Ja izsole atzīta par nenotikušu šā likuma 614. panta pirmās daļas 1. vai 2. punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties paziņo par to visiem kreditoriem un kopīpašniekiem, kā arī apbūves tiesīgajiem, uzaicinot viņus paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev par nenotikušās izsoles sākumcenu. Katram kreditoram un kopīpašniekam, kā arī apbūves tiesīgajam ir tiesības divu nedēļu laikā no tiesu izpildītāja uzaicinājuma nosūtīšanas dienas paziņot tiesu izpildītājam par nekustamā īpašuma paturēšanu sev.  

(2)	Ja izsole atzīta par nenotikušu šā likuma 614.panta pirmās daļas 3.punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties paziņo par to pēdējam pārsolītajam solītājam, uzaicinot viņu paturēt nekustamo īpašumu par viņa solīto augstāko cenu. Pēdējam pārsolītajam solītājam ir tiesības divu nedēļu laikā no tiesu izpildītāja uzaicinājuma nosūtīšanas dienas paziņot tiesu izpildītājam par nekustamā īpašuma paturēšanu sev. Ja pēdējais pārsolītais solītājs nav likumā noteiktajā termiņā paziņojis par nekustamā īpašuma paturēšanu vai atteicies paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties izsludina atkārtotu izsoli.  

(21) Ja izsole atzīta par nenotikušu šā likuma 614.panta pirmās daļas 4.punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties izsludina atkārtotu izsoli.  

(3)	Ja vairākas personas vēlas paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev, rīkojama izsole, kurā piedalās šīs personas, turklāt solīšana sākas no nenotikušās izsoles sākumcenas. Par izsoles laiku un vietu tiesu izpildītājs personām, kuras vēlas paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev, rakstveidā paziņo septiņas dienas iepriekš. Personas neierašanās uz izsoli tiek uzskatīta par atteikšanos no tiesībām piedalīties solīšanā. Ja uz izsoli ierodas viena persona, tā var paturēt sev nekustamo īpašumu par rīkotās izsoles sākumcenu. Ja uz izsoli neierodas neviens, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties izsludina otru izsoli.  

(31) Persona, uz kuru attiecināmas sankcijas, nevar paturēt nekustamo īpašumu, ja īpašuma iegūšana nav savienojama ar ierobežojumiem, kas tai noteikti ar sankcijām.  

(4)	Persona, kas patur sev nekustamo īpašumu, viena mēneša laikā iemaksā tiesu izpildītāja depozīta kontā:

1)	šā likuma 34.panta pirmās daļas 15.punktā noteikto valsts nodevu par pieteikumu par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz ieguvēja vārda;  

2)	valsts  un  kancelejas  nodevu,  kāda  normatīvajā  aktā  noteikta  īpašuma  tiesību  nostiprināšanai

zemesgrāmatā;  

3)	šā panta pirmajā, otrajā vai trešajā daļā norādīto summu;  

4)	pievienotās vērtības nodokli, ja izsoles cena apliekama ar pievienotās vērtības nodokli, atbilstoši tiesu izpildītāja sastādītajam aprēķinam (631.panta trešā daļa) un ņemot vērā šā likuma 612.panta noteikumus.  

(5)	Pēc šā panta ceturtajā daļā minētās summas samaksas tiesu izpildītājs elektroniski iesniedz rajona (pilsētas) tiesā, izmantojot Tiesu informatīvo sistēmu, pieteikumu par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz nosolītāja, kopīpašnieka, apbūves tiesīgā vai kreditora vārda un par zemesgrāmatā ierakstīto parādu dzēšanu (613.pants) un lūdz nostiprināt īpašuma tiesības zemesgrāmatā.  

(6)	Ja neviens nav pieteicies paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev, rīkojama otrā izsole.

### 616. pants. Otrā izsole

(1)	Otro izsoli izziņo un rīko, ievērojot pirmās izsoles noteikumus. Tomēr nekustamā īpašuma solīšana sākas no summas, kas atbilst 75 procentiem no sākumcenas pirmajā izsolē.  

(2)	(Izslēgta ar 17.12.2009. likumu)

(3)	Ja otrā izsole nav notikusi šā likuma 614. panta pirmās daļas 1. un 2. punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ un neviens nav vēlējies paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev, nekustamais īpašums paliek iepriekšējā īpašnieka īpašumā un piedziņas atzīme zemesgrāmatā dzēšama. Ja otrā izsole nav notikusi šā likuma 614. panta pirmās daļas 3. punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ un pēdējais pārsolītais solītājs nav šā likuma 615. panta otrajā daļā noteiktajā kārtībā paziņojis par nekustamā īpašuma paturēšanu vai atteicies paturēt nekustamo īpašumu sev vai ja otrā izsole atzīta par nenotikušu šā likuma 614. panta pirmās daļas 4. punktā paredzētā iemesla dēļ, tiesu izpildītājs nekavējoties izsludina atkārtotu otro izsoli.  
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 31.10.2002., 17.12.2009. un 25.10.2018. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 28.11.2018.)

### 617. pants. Spēkā neesoša izsole

(1)	Tiesa izsoli atzīst par spēkā neesošu, ja:

1)	kādam nepamatoti nav atļauts piedalīties izsolē vai nepareizi atraidīts kāds pārsolījums;  

2)	nekustamo īpašumu nopirkusi tāda persona, kura nav bijusi tiesīga piedalīties izsolē;  

3)	(izslēgts ar 28.05.2015. likumu);  

4)	(izslēgts ar 05.02.2009. likumu);  

5)	piedzinējs vai solītājs rīkojušies ļaunprātīgi;  

6)	vēršot piedziņu uz nekustamo īpašumu, tiesu izpildītājs pieļāvis būtiskus procesuālus pārkāpumus vai konstatēti citi būtiski apstākļi, kas nepieļauj nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz pircēja vārda.  

(2)	Sūdzību par tiesu izpildītāja rīcību, kas dod pamatu prasīt izsoles atzīšanu par spēkā neesošu, ieinteresētās personas 10 dienu laikā no izsoles noslēguma dienas var iesniegt rajona (pilsētas) tiesā.  

(3)	Par tiesas lēmumu var iesniegt blakus sūdzību.  

(4)	Ja nekustamā īpašuma izsole atzīta par spēkā neesošu, rīkojama atkārtota izsole pēc tās izsoles noteikumiem, kura atzīta par spēkā neesošu.  

(5)	(Izslēgta ar 05.02.2009. likumu.)

### 614. Section. Auction that has not taken place

(1) A bailiff shall declare an auction as not having taken place if:

1) no auction participant has been authorised for the auction;

2) none of the participants authorised for the auction outbids the starting price;

3) the successful bidder does not pay the full amount due from him or her within the prescribed time limit (Section 611, paragraph two);

4) during the course of the auction, except in the case referred to in Section 608, paragraph four of this Law, or within 24 hours after the conclusion of the auction, a notification has been received from the security administrator of the electronic auction website regarding significant technical disruptions that may affect the auction result.

(2) The bailiff shall draw up a record and notify the debtor and the owner of the immovable property that the auction is to be considered as not having taken place in the cases referred to in points 1 or 2 of paragraph one of this Section. A notification shall be sent to the participants authorised to participate in the auction using the electronic auction website.

(3) The bailiff shall draw up a record and notify the successful bidder, the debtor and the owner of the immovable property that the auction is to be considered as not having taken place in the case referred to in point 3 of paragraph one of this Section.

(4) Upon receiving the notification referred to in point 4 of paragraph one of this Section, the bailiff shall suspend the auction and post a notification thereof on the electronic auction website during the course of the auction.

(5) The bailiff shall draw up a record and notify the claimant, the debtor and the owner of the immovable property that the auction is to be considered as not having taken place in the case referred to in point 4 of paragraph one of this Section. A notification shall be sent to the participants authorised to participate in the auction using the electronic auction website.
(In the wording of the Law of 28.05.2015. with amendments made by the Law of 04.02.2016., which comes into force on 29.02.2016.)

### 615. Section. Consequences of an auction that has not taken place

(1) If the auction has been declared as not having taken place for the reason provided for in points 1 or 2 of paragraph one of Section 614 of this Law, the bailiff shall immediately notify all creditors and co-owners, as well as holders of building rights, inviting them to retain the immovable property for themselves for the starting price of the auction that has not taken place. Each creditor and co-owner, as well as holder of building rights, shall have the right within two weeks from the date of dispatch of the bailiff's invitation to notify the bailiff of the retention of the immovable property for himself or herself.

(2) If the auction has been declared as not having taken place for the reason provided for in point 3 of paragraph one of Section 614 of this Law, the bailiff shall immediately notify the last outbid bidder, inviting him or her to retain the immovable property for the highest price bid by him or her. The last outbid bidder shall have the right within two weeks from the date of dispatch of the bailiff's invitation to notify the bailiff of the retention of the immovable property for himself or herself. If the last outbid bidder has not notified of the retention of the immovable property within the time limit prescribed by law or has refused to retain the immovable property for himself or herself, the bailiff shall immediately announce a repeated auction.

(21) If the auction has been declared as not having taken place for the reason provided for in point 4 of paragraph one of Section 614 of this Law, the bailiff shall immediately announce a repeated auction.

(3) If several persons wish to retain the immovable property for themselves, an auction shall be held in which these persons participate, and bidding shall start from the starting price of the auction that has not taken place. The bailiff shall notify in writing the persons who wish to retain the immovable property for themselves of the time and place of the auction seven days in advance. The non-appearance of a person at the auction shall be considered as a waiver of the right to participate in the bidding. If one person appears at the auction, he or she may retain the immovable property for himself or herself for the starting price of the auction held. If no one appears at the auction, the bailiff shall immediately announce a second auction.

(31) A person subject to sanctions may not retain the immovable property if the acquisition of the property is not compatible with the restrictions imposed on him or her by sanctions.

(4) A person who retains the immovable property for himself or herself shall, within one month, pay into the bailiff's deposit account:

1) the state fee prescribed in point 15 of paragraph one of Section 34 of this Law for an application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the acquirer;

2) the state and registry fee prescribed in a regulatory enactment for the registration of property rights in the Land Register;

3) the amount specified in paragraph one, two or three of this Section;

4) value added tax, if the auction price is subject to value added tax, in accordance with the calculation prepared by the bailiff (Section 631, paragraph three) and taking into account the provisions of Section 612 of this Law.

(5) After payment of the amount referred to in paragraph four of this Section, the bailiff shall electronically submit to the district (city) court, using the Court Information System, an application for registration of the immovable property in the name of the successful bidder, co-owner, holder of building rights or creditor and for deletion of the debts entered in the Land Register (Section 613) and shall request registration of the property rights in the Land Register.

(6) If no one has applied to retain the immovable property for himself or herself, a second auction shall be held.
(In the wording of the Law of 05.02.2009. with amendments made by the Laws of 17.12.2009., 20.12.2010., 08.09.2011., 12.09.2013., 11.09.2014., 28.05.2015., 01.06.2017., 01.03.2018., 25.10.2018. and 11.11.2021., which comes into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 616. Section. Second auction

(1) The second auction shall be announced and held in compliance with the rules of the first auction. However, the bidding for the immovable property shall start from an amount equal to 75 per cent of the starting price at the first auction.

(2) (Deleted by the Law of 17.12.2009.)

If the second auction has not taken place for the reason provided for in point 3 of paragraph one of Section 614 of this Law and the last outbid bidder has not notified of the retention of the immovable property in the procedure prescribed in paragraph two of Section 615 of this Law or has refused to retain the immovable property for himself or herself, or if the second auction has been declared as not having taken place for the reason provided for in point 4 of paragraph one of Section 614 of this Law, the bailiff shall immediately announce a repeated second auction.

(1) A court shall declare an auction invalid if:

1) someone has been unjustifiably not allowed to participate in the auction or any outbid has been incorrectly rejected;

2) the immovable property has been purchased by a person who was not entitled to participate in the auction;

3) (deleted by the Law of 28.05.2015.);

5) the claimant or bidder has acted in bad faith;

6) when enforcing against the immovable property, the bailiff has committed significant procedural violations or other significant circumstances have been established that do not allow registration of the immovable property in the name of the purchaser.

(2) Interested persons may, within 10 days from the date of conclusion of the auction, submit to the district (city) court a complaint regarding the actions of the bailiff that give grounds for requesting that the auction be declared invalid.

(3) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision.

### 618. pants. Sale of Immovable Property Held in Co-ownership

(1)	When enforcing against one or more owners of undivided immovable property, this property shall be described in its entire composition, but only the debtor's right to his share shall be sold at auction, without separating it in advance.

(2)	Immovable properties held in co-ownership may also be sold in their entire composition if all co-owners so wish and if creditors do not raise objections thereto. The money received from the sale shall be divided among the owners of the immovable property, but the sum due to the debtor shall be used to discharge the debt.

618.1 pants. Procedure for Enforcement of Confiscation of Immovable Property

(1)	The bailiff shall sell the confiscated immovable property specified in the writ of execution and the extract of the protocol or decision attached thereto on the imposition of seizure on property in the procedure laid down in this Chapter.

(2)	A person whose confiscation of immovable property is being enforced does not have the rights of a debtor as laid down in this law.

(3)	If an auction is declared not to have taken place, the right to retain the immovable property in the procedure laid down in this Chapter belongs to the last outbid bidder, the debtor's co-owner and the creditor in the enforcement case for recovery from the person whose immovable property is being confiscated. If the second auction has not taken place and no one has wished to retain the immovable property for themselves, the bailiff shall send a notice to the State Revenue Service, by which the immovable property is transferred to its disposal.

Article 618.2 Notice of enforcement against building rights

(1) If the creditor has requested enforcement against building rights, the bailiff sends a notice to the debtor and invites him to settle the debt, as well as to provide information on whether the debtor is registered as a value added tax payer, whether, when selling his building rights at auction, the auction price is subject to value added tax and what is the taxable value of this price. When executing such decisions that provide for the voluntary sale of building rights at auction through court proceedings or the sale of building rights at forced auction, the notice does not indicate an invitation to the debtor to settle the debt.

(2) The bailiff submits to the district (city) court a request for registration to enter an enforcement note. The consequences of this note are specified in the first part of Article 1077, Articles 1081 and 1305 of the Civil Law, as well as Article 46 of the Land Register Law. An enforcement note shall also be entered when executing such decisions that provide for the voluntary sale of building rights at auction through court proceedings or the sale of building rights at forced auction.

(3) The bailiff, in accordance with the relevant land register section, sends a notice to the owner of the land plot, to the building rights holders who own an ideal share of the building rights, as well as to all mortgage creditors, including persons in whose favour a pledge right or prohibition note has been entered in respect of the building rights, indicating:

1) for the satisfaction of which person's claim enforcement is being directed against the building rights;

2) how large the debt amount is and whether the debt is secured by a mortgage on the respective building rights.

(4) In the notice referred to in paragraph three of this Article, the bailiff requests that the mortgage creditors submit information on the amount of the remaining mortgage debt within the time limit set by the bailiff, which shall not be less than 10 days.

(5) The bailiff requests from the municipality information on real estate tax debt and invites the municipality

to submit a decision on the recovery of tax debt, if such exists.

(6) The bailiff requests from the relevant land register section a copy of the building contract and other documents certifying registration, if such exist.

(7) If the information necessary for the valuation of building rights regarding the construction process commenced on the basis of the building rights is not obtainable from state information system databases, the bailiff, specifically indicating the necessary documents, requests them from the construction board or the institution that performs the functions of the construction board, unless the necessary information or the original of the document is available at another state or municipal institution. A certified real estate appraiser is entitled, on the assignment of the bailiff, to familiarise himself with information available to state or municipal institutions for the valuation of building rights.

(8) If the debtor has paid in full the debt and the costs of execution of the judgment to the bailiff no later than seven days before the auction closing date indicated in the auction announcement, the sale of building rights shall be cancelled, but the auction already commenced shall be terminated. The aforementioned shall not apply when executing such decisions that provide for the sale of building rights at forced auction.
(In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018 with amendments made by the laws of 25.10.2018 and 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 618.3 Debtor's obligations

(1) From the day of receipt of the bailiff's notice, the debtor is prohibited from:

1) alienating the building rights or pledging them;

2) alienating or damaging the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on the basis of the building rights or its accessories;

3) concluding lease and other contracts that reduce or may reduce the value of the building rights or the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on its basis.

(2) Contracts which, contrary to the prohibitions established in paragraph one of this Article, the debtor has concluded after an enforcement note has been made in the land register, shall not be valid in relation to the creditor and the purchaser of the building rights at auction.

(3) The debtor has an obligation to notify, within the time limit set by the bailiff, who is the actual possessor or manager of the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on the basis of the building rights, if such exists, as well as about all concluded lease and other contracts relating to the building rights or the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on its basis, to submit copies of these contracts and to present their originals.

(4) The debtor has an obligation to notify the bailiff whether he is registered as a value added tax payer and whether, when selling his building rights at auction, the auction price is subject to value added tax. If the auction price is subject to value added tax in accordance with the regulatory enactments regulating value added tax, in the said information the debtor indicates the taxable value of this price.
(In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

Article 618.4 Description and management of the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on the basis of building rights

The bailiff describes the non-residential building (engineering structure) erected on the basis of building rights at the request of the creditor in the procedure established in Article 603 of this Law. The management of the described non-residential building (engineering structure) shall be ensured in accordance with Article 605 of this Law.
(In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

Article 618.5 Valuation of building rights

The building rights shall be valued at the debtor's expense at the request of the bailiff by a certified real estate appraiser, determining the forced sale value of the building rights. The valuation shall be notified, as well as the right to request a re-valuation and the procedure by which a re-valuation is carried out, shall be determined according to the provisions of Article 604 of this Law.
(In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018, which enters into force on 01.07.2018.)

Article 618.6 Sale of building rights

(1) The auction of building rights, confirmation of the auction act and registration of building rights in the name of the acquirer shall take place according to the rules provided for the auction of real estate. The bailiff also sends the notice of auction to the owner of the land plot.

(2) In the event of an auction not taking place, in addition to the persons referred to in Article 615 of this Law, if they are not debtors, the owner of the land plot also has the right to retain the building rights.
(In the wording of the law of 01.03.2018 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 619.pants. Tiesas spriedumā norādīto priekšmetu nodošana piedzinējam

(1)	Ja piedzinējam ir piespriesti tiesas spriedumā norādīti noteikti priekšmeti, tiesu izpildītājs šā likuma 555.pantā noteiktajā kārtībā paziņo parādniekam par pienākumu izpildīt spriedumu. Paziņojumā tiesu izpildītājs norāda arī datumu, kad tiks veikta tiesas sprieduma piespiedu izpilde, ja tas nebūs izpildīts. Ja tiesas spriedums izpildāms nekavējoties, tiesu izpildītājs paziņojumā parādniekam nedod termiņu tiesas sprieduma izpildīšanai, bet norāda datumu un laiku, kad tiks veikta tiesas sprieduma piespiedu izpilde.  

(2)	Tiesu izpildītāja noteiktajā sprieduma piespiedu izpildes laikā pēc tiesu izpildītāja pieprasījuma parādniekam ir pienākums uzrādīt izpildu rakstā norādītos piedzinējam nododamos priekšmetus. Pie priekšmetu nodošanas parādniekam un piedzinējam ir tiesības pieaicināt ne vairāk kā divus lieciniekus. Liecinieku neierašanās neaptur sprieduma izpildi.  

(3)	Ja tiesas sprieduma piespiedu izpildes laikā parādnieks neuzrāda spriedumā norādītos piedzinējam nododamos priekšmetus, atsakās darīt zināmu to atrašanās vietu un pēc telpu apskates priekšmeti nav atrasti, tiesu izpildītājs par to sastāda aktu, ko paraksta tiesu izpildītājs, piedzinējs un liecinieki, ja tādi ir piedalījušies. Pēc tam, kad sastādīts akts par piedzinējam nododamās mantas neesamību, tiesu izpildītājs atbilstoši šā likuma noteikumiem veic piespiedu izpildu darbības tiesas spriedumā noteiktās summas (196.pants) piedziņai.  
(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 08.09.2011. un 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

### 620. pants

Sekas, kas rodas, ja neizpilda nolēmumu, kas uzliek parādniekam par pienākumu izpildīt noteiktas darbības

(1)	Ja netiek izpildīts nolēmums, kas uzliek parādniekam par pienākumu izpildīt noteiktas darbības, kuras nav saistītas ar mantas vai naudas summu nodošanu, tiesu izpildītājs sastāda aktu par nolēmuma neizpildīšanu.  

(2)	Ja nolēmumā norādītas šā likuma 197.panta otrajā daļā paredzētās nolēmuma neizpildīšanas sekas, sastādīto aktu nosūta rajona (pilsētas) tiesai pēc izpildīšanas vietas, lai tā pieņemtu lēmumu par nolēmumā norādīto seku piemērošanu sakarā ar to, ka parādnieks neizpilda noteiktas darbības.  

(3)	Ja nolēmumā nav norādītas tā neizpildīšanas sekas, sastādīto aktu nosūta tiesai, kura taisījusi nolēmumu lietā, un šī tiesa izlemj jautājumu par nolēmuma izpildīšanas kārtību saskaņā ar šā likuma 206. u n 438.panta noteikumiem.

### 619.pants. Delivery of items specified in court judgment to the creditor

(1)	If specific items specified in the court judgment have been awarded to the creditor, the bailiff shall notify the debtor of the obligation to execute the judgment in the procedure laid down in Section 555 of this Law. In the notification, the bailiff shall also indicate the date on which the forced execution of the court judgment will be carried out if it has not been executed. If the court judgment is to be executed immediately, the bailiff shall not give the debtor a time limit for execution of the court judgment in the notification, but shall indicate the date and time when the forced execution of the court judgment will be carried out.

(2)	At the time of forced execution of the judgment set by the bailiff, upon the bailiff's request, the debtor has an obligation to present the items specified in the writ of execution to be delivered to the creditor. Upon delivery of the items, the debtor and the creditor have the right to invite no more than two witnesses. The non-appearance of witnesses shall not suspend the execution of the judgment.

(3)	If, at the time of forced execution of the court judgment, the debtor does not present the items specified in the judgment to be delivered to the creditor, refuses to disclose their location, and the items are not found after inspection of the premises, the bailiff shall draw up a report, which shall be signed by the bailiff, the creditor and the witnesses, if any have participated. After a report has been drawn up on the absence of property to be delivered to the creditor, the bailiff shall carry out forced execution actions in accordance with the provisions of this Law for the recovery of the sum specified in the court judgment (Section 196).

(31.10.2002. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 08.09.2011. un 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

### 620. pants

Consequences arising from failure to execute a decision imposing on the debtor an obligation to perform specific actions

(1)	If a decision imposing on the debtor an obligation to perform specific actions not related to the delivery of property or a sum of money is not executed, the bailiff shall draw up a report on the non-execution of the decision.

(2)	If the decision specifies the consequences of non-execution of the decision provided for in the second paragraph of Section 197 of this Law, the report drawn up shall be sent to the district (city) court according to the place of execution so that it may adopt a decision on the application of the consequences specified in the decision in connection with the debtor's failure to perform specific actions.

(3)	If the decision does not specify the consequences of its non-execution, the report drawn up shall be sent to the court that made the decision in the case, and that court shall decide the question of the procedure for execution of the decision in accordance with the provisions of Sections 206 and 438 of this Law.

(4)	If, within the time limit set by the court, a decision imposing on the debtor an obligation to perform actions that can only be performed by the debtor personally (first paragraph of Section 197) is not executed, the bailiff shall send the report drawn up to the court according to the bailiff's place of office. The question of non-execution of the decision shall be decided at a court hearing. The creditor and the debtor shall be notified of the time and place of the hearing. The non-appearance of these persons shall not be an obstacle to considering the question of non-execution of the decision. If the debtor does not execute within the time limit set by the court a decision imposing on the debtor an obligation to perform actions that can only be performed by the debtor personally, the court may impose a fine of up to 3000 euros on the debtor, setting a new time limit for execution of the decision. The fine shall be recovered from the debtor to state revenues. Payment of the fine shall not release the debtor from

the obligation to perform the actions provided for in the court decision.

(5)	If the debtor continues to fail to execute the decision after imposition of the fine, the sworn bailiff shall send a submission to the prosecutor for initiation of criminal proceedings.

(6)	If an employer does not execute a court decision on reinstatement of an unlawfully dismissed or transferred employee, the court, at the employee's request, shall adopt a decision on remuneration for the entire period from the date of making the decision until the date of its execution.

(7)	An appeal may be lodged against the court decision.

(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 12.09.2013., 09.06.2016., 31.05.2018. un 25.03.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 20.04.2021.)

(3)	The eviction shall be carried out in the procedure laid down in Section 620.2 of this Law.

(4)	The debtor has the right to receive one copy of the report describing the property.

620.4 pants. Handling of the debtor's property

(1)	The debtor has the right to receive the property placed in custody within one month by paying the costs of execution of the judgment.

(2)	If the debtor refuses to pay the costs of execution of the judgment, the bailiff shall seize the debtor's property to the value necessary to cover the costs of execution of the judgment, but shall deliver the remaining property to the debtor.

(3)	The bailiff shall sell the seized property in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 71 of this Law.

(4)	The money received from the sale of the property shall be credited to cover the costs of execution of the judgment, but any surplus money shall be paid to the debtor. The bailiff shall notify the debtor of the sale of the property if the bailiff has information about the debtor's official electronic address, e-mail address or place of residence.

(5)	If the debtor does not appear within one month to receive the property placed in custody, the bailiff shall sell it in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 71 of this Law.

(6)	Property that has no market value or cannot be sold and which the debtor has not appeared to receive within the time limit and in the procedure specified in the first paragraph of this Section shall be destroyed by the bailiff in the presence of witnesses, drawing up a report thereof.
