## (Chapter 07

Edition of 09.2006 law, which enters into force on 11.10.2006.)

Article 644.13 Procedure for Hearing Cases

Cases concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia, if the child's place of residence is in another country, shall be heard in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, observing the general provisions of this law.

Article 644.14 Jurisdiction of Cases

(1) Cases concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia, if the child's place of residence is in another country, shall be heard in Riga City Court.

(2) (Deleted by law of 30.10.2014)

(3) If in a case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia the parties conclude a settlement, Riga City Court has jurisdiction to approve the said settlement also in the part concerning custody and contact rights.
(With amendments made by laws of 29.11.2012, 30.10.2014, 14.12.2017, 16.06.2022 and 16.06.2022, which
enters into force on 01.08.2022.)

Article 644.15 Application for the Return of a Child to the Country of His or Her Residence

(1) In order to ensure the return of a child unlawfully removed to Latvia or retained in Latvia to the country of his or her residence, a person whose rights to exercise custody or guardianship have been infringed may submit to the court an application for the return of the child to the country of his or her residence, if the respective country is a contracting state to the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction or the Hague Convention of 19 October 1996 on Jurisdiction, Applicable Law, Recognition, Enforcement and Co-operation in Respect of Parental Responsibility and Measures for the Protection of Children.

(2) The application referred to in paragraph one of this Article may also be submitted to the court by the competent authority in order to apply the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction, the Hague Convention of 19 October 1996 on Jurisdiction, Applicable Law, Recognition, Enforcement and Co-operation in Respect of Parental Responsibility and Measures for the Protection of Children or Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111.

(3) The application shall indicate:

1) the name of the court to which the application is submitted;

2) the applicant's name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none — other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, but if there are none — place of residence or information about his or her whereabouts, as well as an address in Latvia for communication with the court in order to receive court documents. If the applicant agrees to electronic communication with the court, an e-mail address shall also be indicated and, if he or she has registered in the online system for communication with the court, also includes an indication of registration;

3) the name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, other identification data) of the unlawfully removed or retained child and other information about the child, as well as information about the child's possible whereabouts and the identity of the person with whom the child might be;

4) the respondent's name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, other identification data), declared place of residence and additional address indicated in the declaration, as well as place of residence if it differs from the declared place of residence and the additional address indicated in the declaration or information about his or her whereabouts;

5) circumstances confirming the respective person's custody or guardianship rights over the child;

6) circumstances confirming the fact of unlawful removal or retention of the child and the civil aspects;

7) the applicant's request;

71) whether the applicant or his or her representative will participate in the voluntary enforcement of the decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her residence in the territory of Latvia;

72) the applicant's opinion on the possibility of using mediation to resolve the question of the return or non-return of the child to the country of his or her residence;

73) whether proceedings have been brought in a foreign court to hear the case on custody rights on the merits, and the name and address of such foreign court;

8) a list of attached documents;

9) the time of preparation of the application.

(4) The following shall be attached to the application:

1) documents on which it is based;

2) information certified by the competent authorities of the respective foreign country on the legal regulation in the country of the child's residence;

3) a translation into the official language of the application and the documents referred to in points 1 and 2 of this paragraph certified in the prescribed manner.

(5) The application shall be signed by the applicant or his or her representative. If the application is submitted by the applicant's representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the authorisation to apply to the court with this application shall be attached to the application. If the address of the applicant's representative is outside Latvia, an e-mail address shall additionally be indicated or notification shall be given of the registration of his or her participation in the online system.

(6) An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.

(7) The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with this application is not attached to it. The decision is not subject to appeal.
(With amendments made by laws of 04.08.2011, 29.11.2012, 23.04.2015, 23.11.2016, 01.06.2017, 11.11.2021 and
16.06.2022, which enters into force on 07.07.2022. The amendment to paragraph two and points 7.2 and 7.3 of paragraph three enter into force on 01.08.2022. See transitional provision 177)

Article 644.16 Leaving the Application Without Movement

(1) If the application does not comply with the requirements of paragraphs one, two, three and four of Article 644.15 of this law or if the authorisation for the representative to apply to the court with this application does not follow from the power of attorney or other document attached to the application, the court shall leave the application without movement only in such case if the lack of a document or necessary information substantially affects the possibility of hearing the application.

(2) If the court leaves the application without movement in accordance with paragraph one of this Article, the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this law shall occur.
(With amendments made by law of 23.04.2015, which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

Article 644.17 Search for the Respondent and the Child

(1) If the place of residence or whereabouts of the respondent or the child unlawfully removed to Latvia or retained in Latvia is not known, but there is reason to believe that the child is in Latvia, the judge, upon receipt of the application referred to in Article 644.15 of this law, shall adopt a decision on the search for the respondent or the child with the assistance of the police.

(2) The court shall suspend the proceedings if a decision has been adopted on the search for the respondent or the child with the assistance of the police.

(3) The proceedings shall be suspended until the respondent or the child is found.
(Edition of law of 04.08.2011, which enters into force on 01.10.2011.)

Article 644.18 Actions of the Court After Initiation of the Case

(1) The court shall notify the Ministry of Justice of the initiation of the case. The Ministry of Justice shall inform the competent authority of the country of the child's residence thereof in order to apply the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction, the Hague Convention of 19 October 1996 on Jurisdiction, Applicable Law, Recognition, Enforcement and Co-operation in Respect of Parental Responsibility and Measures for the Protection of Children, Council Regulation No 2201/2003 or Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111.

(2) If the application is based on a decision adopted by the competent authority of the respective foreign country on the return of the child, the court may additionally also directly inform the competent authority of the respective foreign country that adopted the decision on the return of the child to the respective country.

(3) Court documents and court summons to the respondent shall be sent in the manner specified in Article 56 of this law.
(With amendments made by laws of 12.06.2009, 29.11.2012, 11.11.2021 and 16.06.2022, which enters into force on 07.07.2022. The amendment to paragraph one enters into force on 01.08.2022. See transitional provision 177)

Article 644.18A Interim Decision

(1) The court, at the request of a party or on its own initiative, shall adopt an interim decision by which, until the adoption of a decision in a case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia, it establishes a prohibition on the removal of the child from the country. The court shall send the decision immediately after its adoption to the State Police and the State Border Guard to the e-mail addresses indicated by them.

(11) The court, at the request of a party, may adopt an interim decision in order to ensure contact between the child and the applicant until the adoption of a decision in a case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia, if it is in the interests of the child.

(2) The request for an interim decision shall be heard in written proceedings and the decision shall be adopted in the form of a resolution within one working day from the date of receipt of the request. The court decision is not subject to appeal.

(21) If the court considers it necessary to clarify additional circumstances for the resolution of the request for contact, the court shall resolve the request for contact no later than in the court session hearing the case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia.

(3) The interim decision shall cease to be effective when it is revoked or when a decision on the return or non-return of the child to the country of his or her residence or a decision terminating the proceedings in the case enters into force in the case concerning the unlawful removal of a child across the border to Latvia or retention in Latvia. In this decision, the court may determine that the prohibition on the removal of the child from the country, except for removal to the country of the child's permanent residence, is effective also after the entry into force of the decision on the return or non-return of the child to the country of his or her residence or the decision terminating the proceedings in the case, but not longer than until the enforcement of the decision.

(4) In exceptional cases, if circumstances have substantially changed and it is in the interests of the child, a party may, after the adoption of the interim decision, request the court to revoke the interim decision. If the court does not establish grounds for revoking the interim decision, it shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application. The court shall adopt the decision to refuse to accept the application in the form of a resolution, and it is not subject to appeal.
(Edition of law of 11.11.2021 with amendments made by law of 16.06.2022, which enters into force on 07.07.2022.)

Article 644.19 Hearing of the Application

(1) The application shall be heard in a court session within 15 days after the initiation of the case, with the participation of the parties. A representative of the orphan's court shall be invited to participate in the court session, and the child's opinion shall be ascertained if the child is capable of formulating it, taking into account his or her age and degree of maturity. The orphan's court shall have the rights of a participant in the case as specified in paragraph two of Article 88 of this law.

(2) If the respondent fails to appear upon the court's invitation without justifiable reason, he or she may be brought to court by force.

(3) If one of the parties lives far away or for another reason cannot appear upon the court's invitation, the court may recognise that written explanations of this party or the participation of its representative are sufficient for the hearing of the case.

(4) When hearing the application, the court shall, on its own initiative, request evidence using the most appropriate procedural possibilities, as well as the fastest method of obtaining evidence.

(5) If the court establishes that the child is in a foreign country, it may adopt a decision to leave the application without hearing.

(6) If the court establishes that the child has been unlawfully removed to Latvia or retained in Latvia, it shall adopt a decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her residence.

(7) The court shall adopt a decision on the return or non-return of the child to the country of his or her residence, applying the provisions of the Hague Convention of 25 October 1980 on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction, Council Regulation No 2201/2003 or Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111.

(8) During the hearing of the case, the court shall endeavour to reconcile the parties, as well as offer to resolve the dispute using mediation if the court considers that in the particular case it is possible to resolve the dispute using mediation. The court shall also ascertain whether proceedings have been brought in a foreign court to hear the case on custody rights on the merits, and the opinion of the participants in the case on the measures for voluntary enforcement of a possible decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her residence.

(9) When adopting a decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her residence, the court shall indicate the time limit for voluntary enforcement of the decision and, if possible, the procedure for voluntary enforcement of the decision. The time limit for voluntary enforcement of the decision shall be determined as not longer than 30 days from the date of entry into force of the decision. In the decision, the court shall warn the respondent — if the decision is not enforced voluntarily, a fine will be imposed and compulsory enforcement will be carried out in the manner specified in this law, and the question of initiating criminal proceedings may also be decided.

(10) In the decision, the court shall impose on the respondent the obligation to immediately notify the Ministry of Justice if he or she changes his or her place of residence or whereabouts before the enforcement of the decision or if the child's whereabouts are changed.

(11) The court, at the request of a party or on its own initiative, in the decision on the return of the child to the country of his or her residence, based on point 5 of Article 27 of Council Regulation (EU) 2019/1111, may include interim measures.
(Edition of law of 04.08.2011 with amendments made by laws of 11.11.2021 and 16.06.2022, which enters into force on 07.07.2022. Amendments to paragraphs five and seven, new edition of paragraph eight and paragraph 11 enter into force on 01.08.2022. See transitional provision 177)

Article 644.20 Entry into Force and Appeal of the Decision

(1) An appeal may be submitted against the court decision. If the decision has been adopted without the presence of a participant in the case, the time limit for submitting an appeal shall be counted from the date of issuance of the decision.

(2) The decision of the court of first instance shall enter into legal force after the time limit for appealing it has expired.
(Edition of law of 04.08.2011 with amendments made by law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.21 Competence of the Regional Court

(1) The regional court shall hear the appeal within 15 days after the initiation of appellate proceedings. The regional court, when hearing the appeal, has the right to:

1) leave the decision unchanged and reject the appeal;

2) revoke the decision and decide the question on the merits.

(2) The decision shall enter into force and is enforceable immediately.
(With amendments made by law of 04.08.2011, which enters into force on 01.10.2011.)

Article 644.22 Actions After Adoption of the Decision

The court shall submit the adopted decision on the non-return of the child to the country of his or her residence and other case materials to the Ministry of Justice.
(With amendments made by laws of 12.06.2009 and 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

## (Chapter 08

In the wording of the law of 12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The chapter enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.23 Jurisdiction over matters concerning the European Account Preservation Order

(1) An application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order shall be submitted to the court in which the claim to be secured is to be brought, or to the court in whose proceedings the case is pending for examination on the merits.

(2) In the case referred to in Article 6(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, where the case on the merits falls within the jurisdiction of a foreign court, the application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order shall be submitted to the district (city) court according to the defendant's declared place of residence or place of residence.

(3) In the case referred to in Article 6(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the claimant may submit the application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order at his or her choice to any district (city) court located in the territorial jurisdiction of the regional court where there is a sworn notary who drew up the relevant notarial deed.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.24 Application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order

(1) In addition to the application referred to in Article 8 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, a document confirming payment of the state fee in the procedure and amount prescribed by law shall be attached, except where the application has been submitted and payment made in an online system.

(2) The application shall be signed by the claimant or his or her representative. If the application has been signed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with the application shall be attached to the application.

(3) An unsigned application shall be deemed not to have been submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.25 Information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution

(1) If the claimant, pursuant to Article 14(1) and (2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, requests the court to obtain information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution, the claimant shall, in addition to that referred to in the first paragraph of Article 644.24 of this Law, attach a document certifying payment of the costs associated with obtaining the information.

(2) If the claimant's request to obtain information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution complies with the requirements referred to in Article 14(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the court shall grant the claimant's request.

(3) In order to obtain the information referred to in the first paragraph of this Article, the court shall send to credit institutions a request to provide information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution.

(4) A credit institution shall, without delay, but not later than on the third day from the day of receipt of the court's request, send to the court information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in the respective credit institution.

(5) The request referred to in the third paragraph of this Article to provide information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution abroad shall be sent by the court to the foreign information authority in the procedure laid down in Article 29 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(6) If the court considers that the claimant's request to obtain information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution is not justified, it shall reject the request. An appeal may be lodged against the decision of the court or judge within the time limit laid down in Article 21(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(7) If a foreign court in which an application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order has been submitted, pursuant to Article 14(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, requests to obtain information on the defendant's funds (accounts) in a credit institution, the court shall obtain this information in the procedure laid down in the first, third and fourth paragraphs of this Article, and shall also send it to the respective foreign court in accordance with Article 14(6) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.26 Ground for non-acceptance of an application

(1) The court shall refuse to accept an application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with the application has not been attached to the application.

(2) The court shall adopt a reasoned decision on the refusal to accept the application. The decision, together with the submitted application, shall be issued to the potential claimant. The decision is not subject to appeal.

(3) A judge's refusal to accept an application in the cases laid down in the first paragraph of this Article shall not be an obstacle to the submission of the same application to the court once the deficiencies have been remedied.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.27 Leaving an application without progress

(1) If the claimant has not provided all the information required by Article 8 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council or has not attached documents certifying payment of the state fee or costs associated with obtaining information, or if the power of attorney or other document attached to the application does not show authorisation for the representative to apply to the court with this application, the court shall leave the application without progress and the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this Law shall ensue.

(2) If the claimant does not remedy the deficiencies within the prescribed time limit and the application is returned to the claimant, the court shall simultaneously adopt a decision on the payment of the sum deposited to secure compensation for loss from the bailiff's account, if the claimant has provided the security for loss referred to in the first paragraph of Article 644.28 of this Law. The decision shall be enforceable immediately.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.28 Security for the defendant's potential loss

(1) The security for loss which the claimant provides in the cases referred to in Article 12 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council in order to secure loss which may be caused to the defendant in connection with the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order shall be provided by depositing the sum determined by the court or judge into the bailiff's deposit account. In the application to the bailiff, the claimant shall indicate pursuant to which court decision on securing the defendant's potential loss this sum is being deposited, and shall also submit the relevant decision to the bailiff.

(2) The court shall adopt a decision on securing loss immediately after submission of the application referred to in Article 644.24 of this Law, but not later than within the time limit referred to in Article 18(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council. The decision is not subject to appeal. The court may adopt the decision on securing loss simultaneously with the decision referred to in Article 644.27 of this Law.

(3) The court shall adopt a decision on the European Account Preservation Order after receipt of the bailiff's notification of the crediting of the sum determined for securing loss to the bailiff's deposit account, except in the cases laid down in the second sentence of Article 12(1) and in Article 12(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council. If the decision referred to in the second paragraph of this Article has been adopted simultaneously with the decision referred to in Article 644.27 of this Law, the decision on the European Account Preservation Order shall be adopted only if the claimant has remedied the deficiencies.

(4) In the case referred to in Article 14(7) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the court shall immediately adopt a decision on the payment of the sum deposited to secure compensation for loss from the bailiff's deposit account. The decision shall be enforceable immediately.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.29 Compensation for loss caused by the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order

(1) In addition to the cases referred to in Article 13(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the defendant is entitled to claim compensation for loss caused to him or her in connection with the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order also where the claim brought against the defendant has been dismissed or left without examination or the proceedings in the case have been terminated in the cases laid down in points 2 and 4 of Article 223 of this Law.

(2) The court, in the judgment or decision by which the claim has been left without examination or the case has been terminated, shall, at the defendant's request, simultaneously decide the question of payment of the sum deposited to secure compensation for loss from the bailiff's deposit account to the defendant. If the request and evidence of the amount of actual loss have not been submitted to the court, the secured loss shall be repaid to the claimant.

(3) When dismissing or partially granting the claim, the court shall decide the question of full or partial payment of the security for loss to the defendant at the defendant's request. If the request and evidence of the amount of actual loss have not been submitted to the court, the secured loss shall be repaid to the claimant. If the claim has been brought in another country, the defendant shall additionally submit evidence that the claim has been dismissed or partially granted.

(4) The defendant is entitled to bring a claim for compensation for loss not recovered pursuant to the first paragraph of this Article.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.30 Decision on the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order

(1) The court shall adopt a decision on the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order or a decision wholly or partially rejecting an application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order in the procedure laid down in Article 17 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council in written proceedings, without prior notification to the defendant and other participants in the case.

(2) The court shall issue the European Account Preservation Order in accordance with Article 19 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council. The court shall, at the claimant's request, carry out transliteration or translation of the order referred to in this paragraph on the basis of Article 23(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(3) A decision of the court or judge wholly or partially rejecting an application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order may be appealed in the procedure laid down in this Law and in the procedure and within the time limit laid down in Article 21 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.31 Revocation of a European Account Preservation Order where no claim has been brought

(1) If the claimant has submitted an application for the issuing of a European Account Preservation Order before bringing a claim and has not brought a claim within the time limit laid down in Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the court or judge, using the form referred to in Article 10(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, shall adopt a decision on the revocation of the European Account Preservation Order on its own initiative. The decision shall be enforceable immediately.

(2) After adopting the decision, the court shall immediately send it to the bailiff in whose proceedings the enforcement case is pending, or, if the decision is enforceable abroad, in the procedure laid down in Article 29 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council
— to the competent authority of the respective foreign country.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.32 Enforcement of a decision on a European Account Preservation Order

(1) A decision on a European Account Preservation Order shall be enforceable immediately after its adoption.

(2) A bailiff shall commence enforcement actions upon the creditor's application, to which Part A of the European Account Preservation Order and a blank standard form for notification pursuant to Article 25 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council are attached.

(3) A bailiff, on the basis of Part A of the European Account Preservation Order, shall give an order to the credit institution to preserve the defendant's funds in the amount specified in Part A of the European Account Preservation Order, observing the restriction laid down in point 3 of Annex 1 to this Law with regard to the defendant and the sequence of preservation of the defendant's accounts laid down in Article 24(7) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, and to transfer them to the bailiff's deposit account.

(4) After receipt of the credit institution's notification of the results of enforcement of the order referred to in the third paragraph of this Article, the bailiff shall send to the court and the claimant a notification of the preservation of the defendant's funds in the credit institution in the procedure laid down in Article 25(2) or — as the case may be — in the second sentence of Article 25(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(5) A request for the release of excessively preserved funds shall be submitted by the claimant to the bailiff in the procedure laid down in Article 27(2) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(6) A bailiff, on the basis of the claimant's request referred to in the fifth paragraph of this Article, shall repay the excessively preserved funds by transferring them to the defendant's account from which the funds were received.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.33 Service of the European Account Preservation Order on the defendant

(1) The European Account Preservation Order and the other documents referred to in Article 28(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council shall be served on the defendant by the court or, in the case referred to in the fourth paragraph of this Article, by the bailiff.

(2) The court which has issued the European Account Preservation Order:

1) after receipt of notification of the preservation of funds, shall, within the time limits laid down in Article 28 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, serve the documents referred to in the first paragraph of this Article on the defendant:

a) if the defendant's place of residence or location is in Latvia,

b) by forwarding the documents to the competent authority of the foreign country in which the defendant's place of residence or location is situated, if the defendant's place of residence or location is in another Member State of the European Union,

c) in the procedure laid down in Chapter 82 or 83 of this Law, if the defendant's place of residence or location is not in one of the Member States of the European Union;

2) at the claimant's request, in the case referred to in the second sentence of Article 28(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, shall immediately send the documents referred to in Article 28(5) of this Regulation to the competent authority of the country of enforcement.

(3) If the European Account Preservation Order has been issued by a foreign court and the defendant's declared place of residence, place of residence, location or registered address is in Latvia, the documents referred to in the first paragraph of this Article shall, at the request of the foreign court or a participant in the case, be served by the court in whose territorial jurisdiction the defendant's declared place of residence, place of residence, location or registered address is situated. The court shall inform the foreign court or the participant in the case, depending on who has submitted the request referred to in this paragraph, of the service of the documents.

(4) A bailiff in whose proceedings there is an enforcement case initiated pursuant to a European Account Preservation Order issued by a foreign court shall, in the case referred to in the second sentence of Article 28(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, at the creditor's written request, send to the defendant whose declared place of residence, place of residence, location or registered address is in Latvia the documents referred to in the first paragraph of this Article. The bailiff shall inform the creditor of the sending of the documents.

(5) The court or bailiff, depending on who has been responsible for service of the documents pursuant to the provisions of this Article, shall, at the claimant's written request, re-send to the defendant the documents referred to in the first paragraph of this Article in the procedure laid down in the third sentence of Article 33(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016 with amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 644.34 Revocation, modification of a European Account Preservation Order, refusal of its enforcement or modification of the procedure for enforcement

(1) The court which has issued the European Account Preservation Order or the court in whose proceedings the case is pending for examination on the merits may revoke or modify the European Account Preservation Order:

1) upon the defendant's application pursuant to Article 33 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council;

2) upon the defendant's or claimant's application pursuant to Article 35(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council;

3) upon the defendant's and claimant's joint application pursuant to Article 35(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(2) The court which has issued the European Account Preservation Order or the court in whose proceedings the case is pending for examination on the merits may refuse enforcement of the European Account Preservation Order or modify the procedure for its enforcement:

1) upon the defendant's application pursuant to point (a) and points (i) and (iii) of point (b) of Article 34(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council;

2) upon the claimant's application pursuant to Article 35(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(3) Having received the defendant's application referred to in point 1 of the first paragraph of this Article, the court may re-decide on the obligation imposed on the claimant pursuant to Article 644.28 of this Law.

(4) The application referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article, submitted using the form referred to in Article 36 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, shall be examined in written proceedings, with prior notification to the participants in the case. Simultaneously with the notification, the court shall send the application to the participants in the case and shall set a time limit for submission of an explanation, except for an application which the defendant has submitted pursuant to point (a) of Article 34(1) or Article 35(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(5) If an application has been submitted pursuant to points (b) and (c) of Article 33(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, the court shall notify the participants in the case thereof, setting a time limit for the claimant to remedy the deficiencies referred to in these points in the procedure laid down in Articles 33(3) and (4) of this Regulation.

(6) If the claimant does not remedy the deficiencies referred to in the fifth paragraph of this Article, the application shall be examined in the procedure laid down in the fourth paragraph of this Article. If the claimant remedies the deficiencies referred to in the fifth paragraph of this Article, the court shall reject the application.

(7) The court shall adopt the decision referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article within the time limit referred to in Article 36(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, and this decision shall be enforceable immediately.

(8) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision using the form referred to in Article 37 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

(9) If the European Account Preservation Order is enforceable abroad, the court shall forward the decision referred to in the first, second and third paragraphs of this Article to the competent authority of the foreign country in the procedure laid down in the second sentence of Article 36(5) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.35 Refusal of enforcement or modification of the procedure for enforcement of a European Account Preservation Order issued by a foreign court

(1) A district (city) court in whose territorial jurisdiction a European Account Preservation Order is enforceable is entitled:

1) upon the defendant's application, in the cases laid down in Article 34 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, or upon the claimant's and defendant's joint application, in the case laid down in Article 35(3) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, to refuse enforcement of the European Account Preservation Order or to modify the procedure for its enforcement;

2) upon the claimant's application, in the case laid down in Article 35(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, to modify the procedure for its enforcement.

(2) The procedure laid down in Article 644.34 of this Law shall apply to the examination of the application referred to in the first paragraph of this Article.

(3) The court shall adopt the decision referred to in the first paragraph of this Article within the time limit referred to in Article 36(4) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, and this decision shall be enforceable immediately.

(4) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision using the form referred to in Article 37 of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

Article 644.36 Replacement of a European Account Preservation Order

(1) The court which has issued the European Account Preservation Order may, upon the defendant's application, on the basis of point (a) of Article 38(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, replace the European Account Preservation Order with the measures for securing a claim provided for in Article 138 of this Law.

(2) The court in whose territorial jurisdiction a European Account Preservation Order issued by a foreign court is enforceable may, upon the defendant's application, on the basis of point (b) of Article 38(1) of Regulation (EU) No 655/2014 of the European Parliament and of the Council, replace the European Account Preservation Order with the measures for securing a claim provided for in Article 138 of this Law.

(3) The application referred to in the first and second paragraphs of this Article shall be examined in written proceedings, with prior notification to the participants in the case. Simultaneously with the notification, the court shall send the application to the participants in the case and shall set a time limit for submission of an explanation.

(4) An appeal may be lodged against the court's decision.

(5) A decision on the replacement of a European Account Preservation Order shall be enforced by the bailiff in whose proceedings there is a case concerning the enforcement of the respective European Account Preservation Order, first securing the claim with the replacement measure for securing a claim and then cancelling the preservation of funds carried out pursuant to the European Account Preservation Order. The sum which has been deposited in the bailiff's deposit account pursuant to the European Account Preservation Order shall be repaid by the bailiff only on the basis of a court ruling.
(In the wording of the law of 08.12.2016, which enters into force on 04.01.2017. The article enters into force on 18.01.2017. See transitional provision point 121)

### 645. pants. Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmums

Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmums ir ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas pieņemts saistošs nolēmums neatkarīgi no tā nosaukuma.

### 646. pants. Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma atzīšana

Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmumu atzīst saskaņā ar šo likumu un Latvijas Republikai saistošiem starptautiskajiem līgumiem.

### 647. pants. Pieteikuma iesniegšana

(1)	Pieteikumu par ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma atzīšanu un izpildīšanu iesniedz izskatīšanai rajona (pilsētas) tiesai pēc nolēmuma izpildīšanas vietas vai arī atbildētāja deklarētās dzīvesvietas, bet, ja tādas nav, — pēc atbildētāja dzīvesvietas vai juridiskās adreses.  

(2)	Pieteikumā norāda šā likuma 638.panta otrajā daļā minētās ziņas.  

(3)	Pieteikumam pievieno:

1)	ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmumu vai pienācīgi apliecinātu nolēmuma atvasinājumu;  

2)	dokumentu, kas apliecina pušu rakstveida vienošanos par strīda nodošanu izskatīšanai šķīrējtiesā;  

3)	pieteikuma un noteiktā kārtībā apliecinātu šīs daļas 1 . u n 2.punktā minēto dokumentu tulkojumu valsts valodā;  

4)	(izslēgts ar 11.11.2021. likumu);  

5)	dokumentu, kas apstiprina valsts nodevas nomaksu likumā noteiktajā kārtībā un apmērā, izņemot gadījumu, kad pieteikums iesniegts un samaksa veikta tiešsaistes sistēmā.  

(4)	Pieteikumu paraksta pieteicējs vai viņa pārstāvis. Ja pieteikumu parakstījis pārstāvis, pieteikumam pievienojama pilnvara vai cits dokuments, kas apliecina pārstāvja pilnvarojumu griezties ar pieteikumu tiesā.  

(5)	Neparakstītu pieteikumu uzskata par neiesniegtu un nosūta atpakaļ iesniedzējam.  

(6)	Tiesnesis pieņem lēmumu par atteikšanos pieņemt pieteikumu, ja tam nav pievienota pilnvara vai cits dokuments, kas apliecina pārstāvja pilnvarojumu griezties ar šo pieteikumu tiesā. Lēmums nav pārsūdzams.  
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 29.11.2012., 23.04.2015. un 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

### 648. pants. Pieteikuma atstāšana bez virzības

Ja pieteikums neatbilst šā likuma 647.panta otrās un trešās daļas prasībām vai ja no pieteikumam pievienotās pilnvaras vai cita dokumenta neizriet pilnvarojums pārstāvim griezties ar šo pieteikumu tiesā, tiesnesis atstāj pieteikumu bez virzības un iestājas šā likuma 133.pantā paredzētās sekas.  
(23.04.2015. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 26.05.2015.)

### 649. pants. Pieteikuma izskatīšana

(1)	Pieteikumu par ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma atzīšanu un izpildīšanu izskata tiesas sēdē, iepriekš par to paziņojot pusēm. Attiecīgo personu neierašanās nav šķērslis pieteikuma izskatīšanai.  

(2)	Tiesa var pieprasīt no pusēm paskaidrojumus vai arī papildu ziņas no ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas, kas pieņēmusi

nolēmumu.  

(3)	Izskatījusi pieteikumu par ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma atzīšanu un izpildīšanu, tiesa pieņem lēmumu atzīt un izpildīt nolēmumu vai noraidīt pieteikumu.  

(4)	Pieteikumu var noraidīt tikai Latvijas Republikai saistošos starptautiskajos līgumos paredzētajos gadījumos.  

(5)	Par tiesas lēmumu var iesniegt blakus sūdzību.

### 650. pants. Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma izpildīšanas nodrošināšana

(1)	Pēc pieteicēja pieteikuma tiesa lēmumā, ar kuru tiek atzīts ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmums, var noteikt šā likuma 138.pantā paredzētos pasākumus ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma izpildīšanas nodrošinājumam.  

(2)	Šā likuma 649.panta piektajā daļā minētās blakus sūdzības iesniegšana neaptur tiesas lēmuma izpildi daļā par ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma izpildīšanas nodrošinājumu.  
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 07.09.2006. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 11.10.2006.)

### 651. pants. Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma izpildīšana

(1)	Ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmumu pēc tā atzīšanas izpilda šajā likumā noteiktajā kārtībā.  

(2)	Ar ārvalsts šķīrējtiesas nolēmuma izpildīšanu saistītos izdevumus sedz vispārējā kārtībā, ja Latvijas Republikai saistošos starptautiskajos līgumos nav noteikts citādi.

### 645. pants. Foreign Arbitral Tribunal Award

A foreign arbitral tribunal award is a binding decision adopted by a foreign arbitral tribunal regardless of its title.

### 646. pants. Recognition of a Foreign Arbitral Tribunal Award

A foreign arbitral tribunal award shall be recognised in accordance with this Law and international treaties binding on the Republic of Latvia.

### 647. pants. Submission of an Application

(1)	An application for recognition and enforcement of a foreign arbitral tribunal award shall be submitted for examination to a district (city) court according to the place of enforcement of the award or the respondent's declared place of residence, but if there is none — according to the respondent's place of residence or registered address.  

(2)	The application shall indicate the information referred to in the second part of Section 638 of this Law.  

(3)	The following shall be attached to the application:

1)	the foreign arbitral tribunal award or a duly certified copy of the award;  

2)	a document certifying the parties' written agreement to submit the dispute for examination to an arbitral tribunal;  

3)	a translation of the application and of the documents referred to in points 1 and 2 of this part, certified in the prescribed manner, into the official language;  

4)	(deleted by the Law of 11.11.2021.);  

5)	a document confirming payment of the state fee in the manner and amount prescribed by law, except where the application has been submitted and payment made in the online system.  

(4)	The application shall be signed by the applicant or his or her representative. If the application has been signed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with the application shall be attached to the application.  

(5)	An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.  

(6)	The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with this application has not been attached to it. The decision is not subject to appeal.  
(With amendments made by the Laws of 29.11.2012., 23.04.2015. and 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 648. pants. Leaving an Application Without Progress

If the application does not comply with the requirements of the second and third parts of Section 647 of this Law or if the authorisation for the representative to apply to the court with this application does not follow from the power of attorney or other document attached to the application, the judge shall leave the application without progress and the consequences provided for in Section 133 of this Law shall ensue.  
(In the wording of the Law of 23.04.2015., which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

### 649. pants. Examination of an Application

(1)	An application for recognition and enforcement of a foreign arbitral tribunal award shall be examined in a court session, with prior notification to the parties. The non-appearance of the relevant persons shall not be an obstacle to the examination of the application.  

(2)	The court may request explanations from the parties or additional information from the foreign arbitral tribunal that adopted the award.  

(3)	Having examined the application for recognition and enforcement of a foreign arbitral tribunal award, the court shall adopt a decision to recognise and enforce the award or to reject the application.  

(4)	The application may be rejected only in the cases provided for in international treaties binding on the Republic of Latvia.  

(5)	An appeal may be lodged against the court decision.

### 650. pants. Securing the Enforcement of a Foreign Arbitral Tribunal Award

(1)	Upon the applicant's application, the court, in the decision by which the foreign arbitral tribunal award is recognised, may determine the measures provided for in Section 138 of this Law to secure the enforcement of the foreign arbitral tribunal award.  

(2)	The lodging of the appeal referred to in the fifth part of Section 649 of this Law shall not suspend the execution of the court decision in the part concerning the securing of enforcement of the foreign arbitral tribunal award.  
(With amendments made by the Law of 07.09.2006., which enters into force on 11.10.2006.)

### 651. pants. Enforcement of a Foreign Arbitral Tribunal Award

(1)	A foreign arbitral tribunal award, after its recognition, shall be enforced in the manner prescribed by this Law.  

(2)	Expenses related to the enforcement of a foreign arbitral tribunal award shall be covered in the general manner, unless otherwise provided for in international treaties binding on the Republic of Latvia.

651.1 pants. Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmums, kurā noteiktās tiesības un pienākumi pielāgojami to īstenošanai Latvijā

Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmums šīs nodaļas izpratnē ir tāds ārvalsts tiesas vai ārvalsts kompetentās iestādes nolēmums, kas saskaņā ar tieši piemērojamām Eiropas Savienības tiesību normām vai Latvijas Republikai saistošiem starptautiskajiem līgumiem ir atzīstams vai pasludināms par izpildāmu Latvijā, kā arī tāds nolēmums, kas ir izpildāms šajā likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, neprasot ārvalsts tiesas nolēmuma atzīšanu un ārvalsts tiesas nolēmuma izpildes pasludināšanu.  

651.2 pants. Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošana to īstenošanai Latvijā

(1)	Ja ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumam pilnā apjomā vai kādā tā daļā nav tiesisko seku Latvijā, jo tajā ir noteiktas tādas tiesības un pienākumi, kas nav pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos, veic ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu to īstenošanai Latvijā. Šajā daļā minēto pielāgošanu veic tikai tajos gadījumos, kad tas paredzēts Eiropas Savienības tiesību normās vai Latvijas Republikai saistošos starptautiskajos līgumos.  

(2)	Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteiktās tiesības un pienākumus pielāgo īstenošanai Latvijā, cik vien iespējams tās pielāgojot attiecīgiem tiesību institūtiem, kas pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos un kam ir līdzvērtīgas tiesiskās sekas, mērķi un nolūki. Ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošana nedrīkst radīt tādas tiesiskās sekas, kas pārsniedz attiecīgās ārvalsts tiesību aktos noteiktās tiesiskās sekas.  

(3)	Ja jautājums par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu īstenošanai Latvijā ir saistīts ar jautājumu par šā nolēmuma atzīšanu vai atzīšanu un izpildīšanu, jautājumus izskata vienlaikus, piemērojot šā likuma 77. un šīs nodaļas noteikumus. Ja ārvalsts tiesas nolēmums ir izpildāms šajā likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, neprasot ārvalsts tiesas nolēmuma atzīšanu un ārvalsts tiesas nolēmuma izpildes pasludināšanu, jautājumu par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu to īstenošanai Latvijā izskata kā atsevišķu

jautājumu, piemērojot tikai šīs nodaļas noteikumus.  

651.3 pants. Pieteikuma iesniegšana

(1)	Pieteikumu par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu īstenošanai Latvijā iesniedz izskatīšanai rajona (pilsētas) tiesā pēc nolēmuma izpildīšanas vietas vai arī pēc atbildētāja deklarētās dzīvesvietas, bet, ja tādas nav, — pēc atbildētāja dzīvesvietas vai juridiskās adreses.  

(2)	Pieteikumā norāda šā likuma 638.panta otrajā daļā minētās ziņas, kā arī pieteicēja lūgumu pielāgot ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteiktās tiesības vai pienākumus, kas nav pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos, attiecīgiem tiesību institūtiem, kas pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos.  

(3)	Ja jautājumu par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu īstenošanai Latvijā izskata kā atsevišķu jautājumu, pieteikumā nenorāda pieteicēja lūgumu atzīt vai atzīt un izpildīt ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumu pilnā apjomā vai kādā tā daļā.  

(4)	Pieteikumam pievieno:

1)	attiecīgo ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumu vai pienācīgi apliecinātu nolēmuma atvasinājumu un noteiktā kārtībā apliecinātu tā tulkojumu valsts valodā;  

2)	attiecīgā ārvalsts likuma tekstu, kas nosaka ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteiktās tiesības vai pienākumus, kas nav pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos, un noteiktā kārtībā apliecinātu tā tulkojumu valsts valodā;  

3)	dokumentu, kas apstiprina attiecīgā ārvalsts likuma saturu, kurš nosaka ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā minētās tiesības vai pienākumus, kas nav pazīstami Latvijas tiesību aktos, un noteiktā kārtībā apliecinātu tā tulkojumu valsts valodā;  

4)	dokumentu, kas apstiprina valsts nodevas samaksu likumā noteiktajā kārtībā un apmērā, izņemot gadījumu, kad pieteikums iesniegts un samaksa veikta tiešsaistes sistēmā.  

(5)	Lietās par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu to īstenošanai Latvijā saskaņā ar Padomes regulas Nr. 606/2013 11.pantu šā panta ceturtās daļas 2. un 3.punktā minētos dokumentus nepievieno.  

(6)	Pieteikumu paraksta pieteicējs vai viņa pārstāvis. Ja pieteikumu parakstījis pārstāvis, pieteikumam pievienojama pilnvara vai cits dokuments, kas apliecina pārstāvja pilnvarojumu griezties ar šo pieteikumu tiesā.  

(7)	Neparakstītu pieteikumu uzskata par neiesniegtu un nosūta atpakaļ iesniedzējam.  

(8)	Tiesnesis pieņem lēmumu par atteikšanos pieņemt pieteikumu, ja tam nav pievienota pilnvara vai cits dokuments, kas apliecina pārstāvja pilnvarojumu griezties ar šo pieteikumu tiesā. Lēmums nav pārsūdzams.  
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 11.11.2021. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.12.2021.)

651.4 pants. Pieteikuma atstāšana bez virzības

Ja pieteikums neatbilst šā likuma 651.3 panta otrās un ceturtās daļas prasībām vai ja no pieteikumam pievienotās pilnvaras vai cita dokumenta neizriet pilnvarojums pārstāvim griezties ar šo pieteikumu tiesā, tiesa atstāj pieteikumu bez virzības un iestājas šā likuma 133.pantā paredzētās sekas.  

651.5 pants. Pieteikuma izlemšana

(1)	Lēmumu par ārvalsts tiesas nolēmumā noteikto tiesību un pienākumu pielāgošanu to īstenošanai Latvijā vai lēmumu par pieteikuma noraidīšanu pieņem tiesnesis vienpersoniski uz iesniegtā pieteikuma un tam pievienoto dokumentu pamata 10 dienu laikā pēc lietas ierosināšanas, neaicinot puses.

## (Chapter 23

Edition of the law of 04.2015, which enters into force on 26.05.2015.)

Article 651.1 Foreign court judgment in which the established rights and obligations are to be adapted for their implementation in Latvia

A foreign court judgment within the meaning of this chapter is such a judgment of a foreign court or a foreign competent authority which, in accordance with directly applicable European Union legal norms or international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia, is recognisable or enforceable in Latvia, as well as such a judgment which is enforceable in the procedure established in this law, without requiring recognition of the foreign court judgment and declaration of enforcement of the foreign court judgment.

Article 651.2 Adaptation of rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia

(1) If a foreign court judgment in its entirety or in any part thereof has no legal effects in Latvia because it establishes such rights and obligations that are not known in the legal acts of Latvia, adaptation of the rights and obligations established in the foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia shall be carried out. The adaptation referred to in this paragraph shall be carried out only in those cases where it is provided for in European Union legal norms or in international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.

(2) The rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment shall be adapted for implementation in Latvia, as far as possible adapting them to the relevant legal institutions that are known in the legal acts of Latvia and which have equivalent legal effects, aims and purposes. The adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment may not produce such legal effects that exceed the legal effects established in the legal acts of the respective foreign country.

(3) If the question of adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for implementation in Latvia is related to the question of recognition of this judgment or recognition and enforcement, the questions shall be examined simultaneously, applying the provisions of Article 77 of this law and this chapter. If a foreign court judgment is enforceable in the procedure established in this law, without requiring recognition of the foreign court judgment and declaration of enforcement of the foreign court judgment, the question of adaptation of the rights and obligations established in the foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia shall be examined as a separate

question, applying only the provisions of this chapter.

Article 651.3 Submission of application

(1) An application for adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for implementation in Latvia shall be submitted for examination to a district (city) court according to the place of enforcement of the judgment or according to the respondent's declared place of residence, but if there is none — according to the respondent's place of residence or registered address.

(2) The application shall indicate the information referred to in the second paragraph of Article 638 of this law, as well as the applicant's request to adapt the rights or obligations established in the foreign court judgment that are not known in the legal acts of Latvia to the relevant legal institutions that are known in the legal acts of Latvia.

(3) If the question of adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for implementation in Latvia is examined as a separate question, the application shall not indicate the applicant's request to recognise or recognise and enforce the foreign court judgment in its entirety or in any part thereof.

(4) The following shall be attached to the application:

1) the relevant foreign court judgment or a duly certified copy of the judgment and its translation into the official language certified in the established procedure;

2) the text of the relevant foreign law that establishes the rights or obligations established in the foreign court judgment that are not known in the legal acts of Latvia, and its translation into the official language certified in the established procedure;

3) a document confirming the content of the relevant foreign law that establishes the rights or obligations mentioned in the foreign court judgment that are not known in the legal acts of Latvia, and its translation into the official language certified in the established procedure;

4) a document confirming payment of the state fee in the procedure and amount established by law, except in cases where the application has been submitted and payment made in the online system.

(5) In cases concerning adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia in accordance with Article 11 of Council Regulation No 606/2013, the documents referred to in points 2 and 3 of the fourth paragraph of this Article shall not be attached.

(6) The application shall be signed by the applicant or his or her representative. If the application has been signed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with this application shall be attached to the application.

(7) An unsigned application shall be considered as not submitted and shall be sent back to the submitter.

(8) The judge shall adopt a decision to refuse to accept the application if a power of attorney or other document certifying the representative's authorisation to apply to the court with this application has not been attached to it. The decision is not subject to appeal.
(With amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 651.4 Leaving the application without movement

If the application does not comply with the requirements of the second and fourth paragraphs of Article 651.3 of this law or if the authorisation of the representative to apply to the court with this application does not follow from the power of attorney or other document attached to the application, the court shall leave the application without movement and the consequences provided for in Article 133 of this law shall occur.

Article 651.5 Resolution of the application

(1) A decision on adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia or a decision to reject the application shall be adopted by the judge individually on the basis of the submitted application and the documents attached to it within 10 days after the initiation of the case, without summoning the parties.

(2) In the cases specified in Article 11 of Council Regulation No 606/2013, the judge shall adopt the decision referred to in the first paragraph of this Article on the next working day after receipt of the application, without summoning the parties. The decision on adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia in accordance with Article 11 of Council Regulation No 606/2013 shall be notified to the respondent in accordance with point 4 of Article 11 of the said regulation.

(3) If, when evaluating the objective circumstances related to the case, in particular — the degree of complexity and volume of the case, the judge considers it impossible to adopt the decision referred to in the first paragraph of this Article within 10 days, he or she shall adopt it as soon as possible.

Article 651.6 Entry into force, enforceability and appeal of the decision of the court of first instance and the court of appeal

(1) An ancillary complaint may be submitted to the regional court against the decision of the court of first instance in a case concerning adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia, and the decision of the regional court on the ancillary complaint may be appealed to the Supreme Court by submitting an ancillary complaint.

(2) A party to the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or registered address is in Latvia may submit the ancillary complaint referred to in the first paragraph of this Article within 30 days from the date of issuance of the decision, but a party to the case whose declared place of residence, but if there is none — place of residence or registered address is not in Latvia — within 60 days from the date of issuance of the decision.

(3) The decision of the court of first instance and the decision of the court of appeal shall enter into legal force after the time limit for its appeal has expired, counting from the date of issuance of the later decision, and an ancillary complaint has not been submitted.

(4) If in the case referred to in the third paragraph of this Article appropriate confirmation of the issuance of the decision has not been received, the decision shall enter into legal force six months after its pronouncement.

(5) The decision of the court of first instance and the decision of the court of appeal in a case concerning adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia in accordance with Article 11 of Council Regulation No 606/2013 shall be enforceable immediately after its adoption.
(With amendments made by the law of 11.11.2021, which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

Article 651.7 Competence of the regional court

(1) The regional court, when examining an ancillary complaint, has the right to:

1) leave the decision unchanged and reject the complaint;

2) revoke the decision in whole or in part and decide the question of adaptation of the rights and obligations established in a foreign court judgment for their implementation in Latvia;

3) amend the decision.

(2) The court may request explanations from the parties or additional information from the foreign court that adopted the judgment.

### 680. pants. Decision on a Foreign Request for Service of Documents

(1)	A foreign request for service of documents shall be decided upon by the Ministry of Justice within 10 days from the date of its receipt.  

(2)	The Ministry of Justice shall adopt one of the following decisions:

1)	on the admissibility of the execution of the request for service of documents, determining the institution executing the request, time limits and other conditions;

(4)	The execution of a foreign request for service of documents may be refused if:

2)	insufficient information has been submitted and it is not possible to obtain additional information.

### 682. pants. Right of the Addressee to Refuse to Accept Documents

(1)	The court shall inform the addressee in writing of its right to refuse to accept documents if they are prepared or have a translation attached in another language, except the official language or a language understood by the addressee.  

(2)	The addressee may refuse to accept documents at the moment of their service or within one week after receipt of the documents, by submitting or sending back the documents to the court that served them. If the addressee refuses to accept documents that are not in the official language or in a language understood by the addressee, the addressee shall notify the court of the language that it understands.  

(3)	If the addressee has refused to accept documents in accordance with paragraphs one and two of this Section, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice thereof, sending back the foreign request for service of documents and the documents for retranslation.

### 683. pants. Costs of Execution of a Foreign Request for Service of Documents

(1)	Expenses incurred in executing a foreign request for service of documents shall be covered from State budget funds, except in the case provided for in paragraph two of this Section.

### 691. pants

(3) The court shall certify the identity of the persons involved and ensure the course of obtaining evidence in Latvia.

### 695. pants. Basis for international civil procedural cooperation in obtaining evidence

(1)	The court shall obtain evidence in Latvia on the basis of a foreign request for obtaining evidence and a decision of the Ministry of Justice on the admissibility of the foreign request for obtaining evidence.

(2)	The court shall, in the cases and procedure provided for in this Law, on its own initiative or at the reasoned request of a party to the case, decide on a Latvian request for obtaining evidence.

### 696. pants. Competence of the Ministry of Justice in obtaining evidence

The Ministry of Justice shall receive and decide on foreign requests for obtaining evidence and send Latvian requests for obtaining evidence in accordance with the Hague Convention of 1970 and other international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.

### 697. pants. Language of the request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto

The request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto shall be prepared and submitted in the language specified as the language of communication in the application of international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.

### 698. pants. Form of the request for obtaining evidence

(1)	The court shall submit the Latvian request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto to the Ministry of Justice.

(2)	The Latvian request for obtaining evidence shall be signed by the judge and certified with the seal of the court.

(3)	The Ministry of Justice may submit the Latvian request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto to a foreign State by other means of communication, also submitting them as a postal item.

(4)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto may be received by other means of communication if they are also submitted as a postal item.

1)	to permit parties to the case or their representatives to participate in obtaining evidence in accordance with Article 7 of the Hague Convention of 1970;

2)	to permit representatives of the court to participate in obtaining evidence in accordance with Article 8 of the Hague Convention of 1970.

### 700. pants. Decision on a foreign request for obtaining evidence

(1)	The Ministry of Justice shall decide on a foreign request for obtaining evidence within seven days from the date of its receipt.

(2)	The Ministry of Justice shall adopt one of the following decisions:

1)	on the admissibility of the execution of the request for obtaining evidence, specifying the authority executing the request for obtaining evidence, time limits and other conditions;

2)	on refusal to accept the request for obtaining evidence or part thereof for execution in the cases provided for in international agreements binding on the Republic of Latvia.

(3)	When examining a foreign request for obtaining evidence submitted in accordance with Article 16 or 17 of the Hague Convention of 1970, the Ministry of Justice shall adopt one of the following decisions:

1)	on the admissibility of the execution of the request for obtaining evidence, specifying that the district (city) court in whose territory of operation the source of the evidence to be obtained is located shall participate in the execution of the said request, the time limits for the execution of the request for obtaining evidence and other conditions;

2)	on refusal to accept the request for obtaining evidence or part thereof for execution.

(4)	The decision of the Ministry of Justice is not subject to appeal.

### 701. pants. General provisions for the execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence

(1)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be executed by the district (city) court in whose territory of operation the source of the evidence to be obtained is located.

(2)	If the court to which the foreign request for obtaining evidence has been submitted in accordance with paragraph one of this Section ascertains that part of the evidence is located in another city or district, it shall instruct the relevant court to perform certain procedural acts in accordance with Sections 102 and 103 of this Law.

(3)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be executed in the procedure laid down in this Law, except in cases where the execution of the foreign request for obtaining evidence is permitted in accordance with foreign procedural rules at the request of the foreign competent authority.

(4)	The execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be commenced immediately after the decision on the admissibility of the execution of the request for obtaining evidence has been adopted. If it is not possible to execute the foreign request for obtaining evidence within 90 days from the date of its receipt, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice thereof in writing, indicating the reasons preventing the execution of the said request.

(5)	If the execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence is difficult or impossible, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice in writing of the reasons for non-execution of the said request.

(2)	The court shall ascertain whether representatives of the foreign competent court, parties or their representatives require an interpreter.

(3)	If the persons referred to in paragraph one of this Section do not understand the official language and if there are no significant practical difficulties, an interpreter shall participate in obtaining evidence at the request of representatives of the foreign competent court or parties or their representatives.

### 703. pants. Obtaining evidence using technical means

(1)	If the execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence using technical means has been permitted, such foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be executed by the district (city) court which has access to the technical means necessary for obtaining evidence.

(2)	An interpreter shall, if necessary, participate in obtaining evidence in Latvia or in a foreign State using technical means.

(3)	The court shall certify the identity of the persons involved and ensure the course of obtaining evidence in Latvia.

(7)	Tieslietu ministrijas lēmums nav pārsūdzams.

### 712. pants. Ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūguma izpildes vispārīgie noteikumi

(1)	Ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūgumu izpilda rajona (pilsētas) tiesa, kuras darbības teritorijā atrodas iegūstamā pierādījuma avots.  

(2)	Ja tiesa, kurai ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūgums iesniegts saskaņā ar šā panta pirmo daļu, konstatē, ka daļa pierādījumu atrodas citā pilsētā vai rajonā, tā uzdod attiecīgajai tiesai izdarīt noteiktas procesuālās darbības atbilstoši šā likuma 102. un 103.pantam.  

(3)	Ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūgumu izpilda šajā likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, izņemot gadījumus, kad ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūguma izpilde pieļauta ārvalsts procesuālajā kārtībā pēc ārvalsts kompetentās iestādes lūguma.  

(4)	Ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūguma izpildi uzsāk nekavējoties pēc tam, kad pieņemts lēmums par pierādījumu iegūšanas lūguma izpildes pieļaujamību. (5)	Ja ārvalsts pierādījumu iegūšanas lūguma izpilde ir apgrūtināta vai neiespējama, tiesa rakstveidā paziņo Tieslietu ministrijai minētā lūguma neizpildes iemeslus.
