### 704. Section. Rights of witnesses to refuse to give testimony

(1)	When executing a foreign request for obtaining evidence, the court shall ascertain whether the obstacles specified in Section 106 of this Law exist, and shall also explain to witnesses their rights to refuse to give testimony in the cases provided for in Section 107 of this Law.

(2)	When executing a foreign request for obtaining evidence in accordance with the 1970 Hague Convention, the court shall also explain to witnesses their rights to refuse to give testimony in accordance with the law of the requesting State.

### 705. Section. Costs of execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence

(1)	In accordance with the second part of Article 14 of the 1970 Hague Convention, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice of the costs of execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence, if such costs have arisen.

(2)	The Ministry of Justice may request the competent authority of a foreign state to cover the costs of execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence that have arisen in accordance with the second part of Article 14 of the 1970 Hague Convention.

Chapter 86
International civil procedural cooperation in obtaining evidence if there is no treaty with a foreign state providing for cooperation in obtaining evidence

### 706. Section. Basis for international civil procedural cooperation in obtaining evidence

(1)	The court shall obtain evidence in Latvia on the basis of a foreign request for obtaining evidence and a decision of the Ministry of Justice on the admissibility of the foreign request for obtaining evidence.

(2)	The court, in the cases and procedure provided for in this Law, on its own initiative or upon a reasoned request of a party to the case, shall decide the question of a Latvian request for obtaining evidence.

(3)	Obtaining evidence within the meaning of this Chapter also includes securing evidence in the procedure established by this Law.

### 707. Section. Competence of the Ministry of Justice in obtaining evidence

(1)	If there is no treaty with a foreign state providing for cooperation in obtaining evidence, a Latvian request for obtaining evidence shall be submitted and a foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be received and decided by the Ministry of Justice.

(2)	The Ministry of Justice may request or issue to a foreign state a confirmation that reciprocity will be observed in cooperation, that is, that in future the cooperation partner will provide assistance observing the same principles.

(3)	If necessary, the Ministry of Justice shall send a Latvian request for obtaining evidence to a foreign state through the intermediary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, using consular or diplomatic channels.

### 708. Section. Content of a request for obtaining evidence

(1)	A request for obtaining evidence shall indicate:

1)	the name of the court submitting the request for obtaining evidence;

2)	the subject and substance of the request for obtaining evidence;

3)	information about the parties to the case and their representatives: for natural persons — name, surname, personal identity number (if there is none, other identification data) and place of residence, and for legal persons — name, registration number and legal address;

4)	the substance of the case and a brief statement of facts;

5)	information about the evidence to be obtained and its connection with the case;

6)	information about the cases provided for by law in which witnesses may refuse to give testimony;

7)	other information necessary for the execution of the request for obtaining evidence.

(2)	In a Latvian request for obtaining evidence, the court, on its own initiative or upon a reasoned request of a party to the case, may request:

1)	permission for the parties to the case or their representatives to be present or participate in obtaining evidence;

2)	permission for representatives of the court to be present or participate in obtaining evidence;

3)	to obtain evidence using technical means;

4)	to obtain evidence in the procedural procedure provided for in this Law.
(With amendments made by the Law of 29.11.2012., which enters into force on 01.01.2013.)

### 709. Section. Language of a request for obtaining evidence and documents attached thereto

(1)	A Latvian request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto shall be prepared and submitted in the official language, attaching a translation in one of the following languages:

1)	the language of the receiving State;

2)	another language, by mutual agreement between the competent authorities of Latvia and the foreign state.

(2)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be accepted prepared or with an attached translation in the official language, Russian or English.

(3)	If it is not possible to provide a translation in one of the languages referred to in the second paragraph of this Section, the competent authorities of Latvia and the foreign state may mutually agree on another language in which the foreign request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto are to be prepared or in which a translation is to be attached thereto.

### 710. Section. Form of a request for obtaining evidence

(1)	(Deleted by the Law of 11.11.2021.)

(2)	A Latvian request for obtaining evidence shall be signed by a judge and certified with the seal of the court.

(3)	The Ministry of Justice may submit a Latvian request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto to a foreign state by other means of communication, also submitting them as a postal item.

(4)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence and the documents attached thereto may be accepted by other means of communication if they are also submitted as a postal item.
(With amendments made by the Law of 11.11.2021., which enters into force on 01.12.2021.)

### 711. Section. Decision on a foreign request for obtaining evidence

(1)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be decided by the Ministry of Justice within 10 days from the date of its receipt.

(2)	The Ministry of Justice shall adopt one of the following decisions:

1)	on the admissibility of execution of the request for obtaining evidence, determining the authority for execution of the request for obtaining evidence, time limits and other conditions;

2)	on refusal to accept the request for obtaining evidence or part thereof for execution, giving reasons for the refusal.

(3)	If additional information is necessary for deciding the request for obtaining evidence, the Ministry of Justice shall request it from the competent authority of the relevant foreign state.

(4)	Execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence may be refused if:

1)	execution of the foreign request for obtaining evidence is contrary to the public order of Latvia;

2)	sufficient information has not been submitted and it is not possible to obtain additional information;

3)	execution of the foreign request for obtaining evidence is difficult.

(5)	If execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence is refused, the Ministry of Justice shall immediately notify the competent authority of the requesting State thereof.

(6)	Refusal to execute a foreign request for obtaining evidence or part thereof does not prevent the competent authority of the foreign state from resubmitting the same request after remedying the deficiencies.

(7)	A decision of the Ministry of Justice is not subject to appeal.

### 712. Section. General provisions for execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence

(1)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be executed by the district (city) court in whose territory of operation the source of the evidence to be obtained is located.

(2)	If the court to which a foreign request for obtaining evidence has been submitted in accordance with the first paragraph of this Section ascertains that part of the evidence is located in another city or district, it shall instruct the relevant court to perform certain procedural actions in accordance with Sections 102 and 103 of this Law.

(3)	A foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be executed in the procedure established by this Law, except in cases where execution of the foreign request for obtaining evidence is permitted in the foreign procedural procedure at the request of the competent authority of the foreign state.

(4)	Execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be commenced immediately after a decision on the admissibility of execution of the request for obtaining evidence has been adopted. If it is not possible to execute the foreign request for obtaining evidence within 90 days from the date of its receipt, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice thereof in writing, indicating the reasons that hinder execution of the said request.

(5)	If execution of a foreign request for obtaining evidence is difficult or impossible, the court shall notify the Ministry of Justice in writing of the reasons for non-execution of the said request.

### 713. Article

Execution of a foreign evidence request in the presence of or with the participation of parties or representatives of the foreign competent court

(1)	If execution of a foreign evidence request is permitted, with parties or their representatives, or representatives of the foreign competent court present or participating in the obtaining of evidence, the court executing the foreign evidence request shall notify the foreign competent authority or directly the representatives of the foreign competent court or the parties or their representatives of the time and place of obtaining evidence, as well as the conditions of participation.

(2)	The court shall ascertain whether an interpreter is necessary for the representatives of the foreign competent court, the parties or their representatives.

(3)	If the persons referred to in paragraph one of this Article do not understand the official language and if there are no substantial practical difficulties, an interpreter shall participate in the obtaining of evidence at the request of the representatives of the foreign competent court or the parties or their representatives.

### 714. Article. Obtaining evidence using technical means

(1)	If execution of a foreign evidence request using technical means is permitted, such a foreign evidence request shall be executed by the district (city) court which has access to the technical means necessary for obtaining evidence.

(2)	An interpreter shall participate, if necessary, in the obtaining of evidence in Latvia or abroad using technical means.

(3)	The court shall certify the identity of the persons involved and ensure the course of obtaining evidence in Latvia.

### 715. Article. Rights of witnesses to refuse to give testimony

(1)	When executing a foreign evidence request, the court shall ascertain whether the obstacles referred to in Article 106 of this Law exist, and shall also explain to witnesses their rights to refuse to give testimony in the cases provided for in Article 107 of this Law.

(2)	When executing a foreign evidence request, witnesses may also refuse to give testimony in accordance with the law of the requesting State, if such rights are indicated in the foreign evidence request or have otherwise been confirmed by the foreign competent authority.

47. Lietas par laulības šķiršanu pēc abu laulāto kopīga iesnieguma un lietas par saistības priekšmeta iesniegšanu tiesai glabājumā, kuras līdz 2011.gada 31.janvārim pieņemtas izskatīšanai tiesās, izskata Civilprocesa likumā

noteiktajā kārtībā, kāda bija spēkā līdz 2011.gada 31.janvārim. (28.10.2010. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.02.2011.)

48. Kustamās mantas izsole, kas izsludināta līdz 2011.gada 31.janvārim, rīkojama saskaņā ar tiem noteikumiem, kādi bija spēkā izsoles izziņošanas dienā. (28.10.2010. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.02.2011.)

49. Šā likuma 34.panta pirmās daļas 7.punkta jaunā redakcija (kas paredz valsts nodevas apmēru par pieteikumu par bezstrīdus piespiedu izpildīšanu, par saistību piespiedu izpildīšanu brīdinājuma kārtībā vai par nekustamā īpašuma labprātīgu pārdošanu izsolē tiesas ceļā — 2 procenti no parāda summas vai atdodamās vai labprātīgā izsolē pārdodamās mantas vērtības, bet ne vairāk par 350 latiem) stājas spēkā 2011.gada 1.februārī. (20.12.2010. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2011.)

50. Šā likuma 587.panta sestās daļas jaunā redakcija (kas paredz, ka persona, kura nosolījusi pārdodamo priekšmetu, samaksā pilnu nosolīto summu un pievienotās vērtības nodokli, ja izsoles cena apliekama ar pievienotās vērtības nodokli, ne vēlāk kā nākamajā darbdienā pēc izsoles) stājas spēkā 2011.gada 1.februārī. (20.12.2010. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2011.)

51. Attiecībā uz kustamas mantas un nekustamā īpašuma izsolēm, kuras izsludinātas līdz 2010.gada 31.decembrim, tiek piemērotas tās Civilprocesa likuma normas, kas bija spēkā līdz 2010.gada 31.decembrim. (20.12.2010. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2011.)

52. Šā likuma 133.panta pirmās daļas 3.punkts, 30.3 nodaļa, kā arī grozījumi šā likuma 37.panta pirmajā daļā,
406.4 panta otrajā un ceturtajā daļā, 406.6 panta otrajā un trešajā daļā, 406.8 panta otrajā un trešajā daļā, 450.panta pirmajā un trešajā daļā un 486.panta piektajā daļā stājas spēkā 2011.gada 1.oktobrī. (08.09.2011. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 30.09.2011.)

53. Šā likuma 30.3 nodaļas noteikumi nav piemērojami tādu prasības pieteikumu izskatīšanai, kas saņemti tiesā līdz 2011.gada 30.septembrim. (08.09.2011. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 30.09.2011.)

54. Līdz 2011.gada 30.septembrim samaksāto valsts nodevu lietās par saistību piespiedu izpildīšanu brīdinājuma kārtībā atmaksā Civilprocesa likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, kāda bija spēkā līdz 2011.gada 30.septembrim. (08.09.2011. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 30.09.2011.)

55. Grozījums šā likuma 486.panta piektajā daļā par šķīrējtiesu nosaukumu atšķiramību neattiecas uz šķīrējtiesas nosaukumu, kas šķīrējtiesu reģistrā ierakstīts līdz 2011.gada 30.septembrim. (08.09.2011. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 30.09.2011.)

56. Šā likuma 24.panta otrais teikums [par rajona (pilsētas) tiesas zemesgrāmatu nodaļas kompetenci pieteikumu par bezstrīdus piespiedu izpildīšanu un saistību piespiedu izpildīšanu brīdinājuma kārtībā izskatīšanā] un 566.panta trešā daļa, kā arī grozījums, kas paredz izslēgt 34.panta otrās daļas ievaddaļu, un grozījumi 403.pantā un 406.2 panta otrajā daļā [par pieteikumu iesniegšanu rajona (pilsētas) tiesas zemesgrāmatu nodaļā] stājas spēkā 2012.gada 1.janvārī. (04.08.2011. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.10.2011.)

57. Administrators, kuru tiesa ar lēmumu ir atcēlusi no viņa pienākumu pildīšanas laika posmā no 2010.gada
1.novembra līdz 2012.gada 1.jūlijam uz Maksātnespējas likuma 22.panta otrās daļas 7.punkta pamata, šo tiesas lēmumu var pārsūdzēt šā likuma 341.8 panta septītajā daļā, 363.14 panta divpadsmitajā daļā vai 363.28 panta devītajā daļā noteiktajā kārtībā līdz 2012.gada 11.jūlijam. Apgabaltiesas lēmums nav pamats administratora atjaunošanai maksātnespējas procesā vai tiesiskās aizsardzības procesā, no kura viņš tika atcelts. (21.06.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.07.2012.)

58. (Izslēgts ar 19.12.2013. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 04.01.2014.)

59. Ja tiesa nodibinājusi pagaidu aizgādnību, pamatojoties uz likuma "Par atjaunotā Latvijas Republikas 1937.gada Civillikuma ģimenes tiesību daļas spēkā stāšanās laiku un kārtību" 21.panta 1.punktu, un mēneša laikā pēc šo grozījumu spēkā stāšanās dienas nav iesniegts pieteikums par personas rīcībspējas ierobežošanu un aizgādnības nodibināšanu, tiesnesis pieņem lēmumu par pagaidu aizgādnības izbeigšanu. Lēmums par pagaidu aizgādnības izbeigšanu nosūtāms bāriņtiesai izpildīšanai, prokuroram, aizgādnim un personai, kuras rīcībspēja ierobežota. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

60. Ja tiesa apturējusi tiesvedību, pamatojoties uz likuma "Par atjaunotā Latvijas Republikas 1937.gada Civillikuma ģimenes tiesību daļas spēkā stāšanās laiku un kārtību" 21.panta 2. un 3.punktu, tā atjauno tiesvedību pēc savas iniciatīvas, pēc lietas dalībnieka vai aizgādņa pieteikuma. Ja persona, kas ir pieteicējs apturētajā lietā, zaudējusi prasības tiesības lietās par aizgādnības nodibināšanu vai rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu saskaņā ar grozījumiem Civillikumā un Civilprocesa likumā, kuri stājās spēkā 2013.gada 1.janvārī, tiesa to paziņo prokuratūrai un pieteicēja vietā iestājas prokurors. Atjaunojot tiesvedību, tiesa izskaidro pieteicējam viņa tiesības grozīt pieteikuma priekšmetu un pamatojumu. Šādas lietas tiesā izskata Civilprocesa likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, kāda ir spēkā no šo grozījumu spēkā stāšanās dienas. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 23.05.2013. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2013.)

61. Persona, kuru tiesa līdz 2011.gada 31.decembrim atzinusi par rīcībnespējīgu gara slimības vai plānprātības dēļ un nodibinājusi aizgādnību tās izlaidīgas vai izšķērdīgas dzīves dēļ, kā arī alkohola vai citu apreibinošo vielu lietošanas dēļ, turpmāk uzskatāma par personu ar rīcībspējas ierobežojumu bez personisko nemantisko tiesību ierobežojuma. Līdz brīdim, kad stājas spēkā attiecīgie grozījumi citos normatīvajos aktos, tiesiskais regulējums attiecībā uz rīcībnespējīgo personu un to personu, kurai nodibināta aizgādnība tās izlaidīgas vai izšķērdīgas dzīves dēļ, kā arī alkohola vai citu apreibinošo vielu lietošanas dēļ, tulkojams un piemērojams saskaņā ar šajā likumā un Civillikumā noteikto. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

62. Šo pārejas noteikumu 61.punktā minētās personas rīcībnespēja pārskatāma pēc tādiem pašiem noteikumiem kā personai ar rīcībspējas ierobežojumu. Aizgādnim ir pienākums par šo pārejas noteikumu 61.punktā minēto personu iesniegt tiesā pieteikumu par rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu četru gadu laikā pēc šo grozījumu spēkā stāšanās, ja pieteikums par rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu nav iesniegts tiesā vai attiecībā uz to nav stājies spēkā spriedums. Ja pēc minētā termiņa tiesā nav iesniegts pieteikums par personas rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu vai attiecībā uz to nav stājies spēkā spriedums, bāriņtiesa gada laikā no iepriekš minētā aizgādnim uzliktā pienākuma termiņa notecējuma informē prokuratūru par tādām rīcībnespējīgām personām, kurām nepieciešams pārskatīt rīcībspējas ierobežojumu.

### Article 716. Costs of Executing a Foreign Request for Obtaining Evidence

(1) Expenses incurred in executing a foreign request for obtaining evidence shall be covered from state budget funds, except in the case provided for in the second paragraph of this Article.
(2) The court that executes a foreign request for obtaining evidence shall notify the Ministry of Justice of the following costs of executing the said request:

1) amounts of expenses payable to experts and interpreters;
2) expenses incurred in cases provided for by law when executing a foreign request for obtaining evidence in accordance with foreign procedural procedure;
3) costs incurred if the foreign request for obtaining evidence has been executed at the request of a foreign competent authority using technical means.
(3) The Ministry of Justice may request the foreign competent authority to cover the costs provided for in the second paragraph of this Article.
Civil Procedure Law
Annex 1

List of Property on Which Enforcement May Not Be Levied Under Enforcement Documents
(Annex with amendments made by the Law of 17 June 2004, which enters into force on 1 July 2004.)

The following types of property and items belonging to the debtor or constituting his or her share in joint ownership are not subject to levy of enforcement under enforcement documents:

1. Household furnishings and household items, clothing necessary for the debtor, his or her family members, as well as persons who are his or her dependants:

1) necessary everyday clothing, footwear and linen;
2) bedding, bed linen and towels;
3) kitchen and table utensils necessary for daily use;
4) furniture — one bed and one chair per person, as well as one table and one cupboard per family;
5) all children's belongings.
2. Food products kept at home in such quantity as is necessary for the maintenance of the debtor and his or her family members for three months.
3. Money in the amount of the minimum monthly wage for the debtor, each of his or her family members and dependants, but in cases of enforcement of maintenance for minor children or in favour of the Maintenance Guarantee Fund Administration — money in the amount of 50 per cent of the minimum monthly wage for the debtor, each of his or her family members and dependants.
4. Per family, one cow or goat and one pig, as well as fodder in such quantity as is necessary until the harvesting of new fodder or until the driving of livestock to pasture.
5. Fuel necessary for the family for cooking food and heating living quarters during the heating season.
6. Books, instruments and tools necessary for the debtor in his or her personal daily work to obtain the means necessary for subsistence.
7. Agricultural inventory, that is, agricultural implements, machinery, livestock and seed necessary for a farm, together with the amount of feed necessary for the maintenance of the livestock of the respective farm until the new harvest. What agricultural implements, how many livestock and what amounts of feed are to be considered necessary shall be determined by an instruction of the Minister of Agriculture.
8. Movable property which under the Civil Law is recognised as an appurtenance of immovable property — separately from such immovable property.
9. Places of worship and ritual objects.
Civil Procedure Law
Annex 2

Procedure for Restoring Lost Court Proceedings or Enforcement Proceedings Materials
(Annex with amendments made by the Law of 11 November 2021, which enters into force on 1 December 2021.)

1. The court may restore lost court proceedings or enforcement proceedings materials in a civil case upon an application by a party to the case, upon a submission by a bailiff or prosecutor, or on its own initiative.
2. Lost court proceedings materials shall be restored in full or in the part which it is necessary to restore in the court's opinion. If there has been a court judgment or decision on termination of proceedings in the case, it must be restored.
3. An application for restoration of lost court proceedings materials or an enforcement order shall be submitted to the court that heard the case, but an application for restoration of lost enforcement proceedings materials (except an enforcement order) shall be submitted to the district (city) court according to the place of enforcement.
4. The application shall indicate precise information about the case. Documents that have been preserved with the applicant and that relate to the case shall be attached to the application, even if they have not been certified in the prescribed manner.
5. When hearing the case, the court shall use preserved parts of the court proceedings materials, request from the parties to the case or other persons documents that were issued to them before the loss of the court proceedings materials, as well as other materials relating to the case. The parties to the case are entitled to submit for consideration a draft of the judgment or decision to be restored prepared by them.
6. The court may examine as witnesses persons who were present during the performance of procedural actions, and, if necessary, persons who were part of the court composition when hearing the case whose court proceedings materials have been lost, as well as persons who executed the court judgment.
7. If the collected materials are insufficient to accurately restore the lost court proceedings materials, the court shall by decision terminate the examination of the application for restoration of court proceedings materials. In this case, the applicant is entitled to re-submit a claim or application in the general procedure. Expenses related to the hearing of such a case shall be covered by the state.
8. Expenses incurred by the court in hearing a case on restoration of lost materials shall be covered by the state. If a knowingly false application has been submitted, the court expenses shall be recovered from the applicant.
Transitional Provisions

1. The procedure for hearing cases arising from administrative legal relations, until the day the administrative procedure law enters into force, shall be regulated by the general provisions of the Civil Procedure Law and the provisions of Chapters Twenty-Two, Twenty-Three, Twenty-Three-A, Twenty-Four, Twenty-Four-A and Twenty-Five of the Latvian Code of Civil Procedure.
2. The provisions of the second paragraph of Article 548, Articles 550 and 632, second paragraph, of this Law shall be applicable after the respective amendments to the Law "On Judicial Power" enter into force. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002 with amendments made by the Laws of 1 December 2005 and 11 December 2008, which enters into force on 31 December 2008.)

3. Until the day the amendments to the Law "On Judicial Power" referred to in Point 2 of the transitional provisions enter into force:

1) the correct and timely execution of court judgments shall be supervised by the Bailiffs Department of the Ministry of Justice;
2) a decision of the senior bailiff by which an application for recusal of a bailiff has been left without satisfaction may be appealed to the Bailiffs Department of the Ministry of Justice. The submission of a complaint shall not suspend enforcement actions;
3) complaints about the actions of bailiffs or their refusal to perform such actions may be submitted to the court by the creditor or debtor

only after the complaint has been examined by the Bailiffs Department of the Ministry of Justice. A complaint may be submitted to the court within 10 days from the day the complainant received a response from the Bailiffs Department, or from the day a one-month period has expired after submission of the complaint and the applicant has not received a response to it.
4. If immovable property is not registered in the Land Register (in cases provided for by law, apartment property — in the Cadastre Register), when securing a claim with it or levying enforcement on it, the immovable property shall be described and transferred for administration in accordance with the provisions of the second to fourth paragraphs of Article 603 and Article 605 of this Law. Before describing the immovable property, the bailiff shall ascertain its ownership or its possessor by requesting information from the State Land Service or the respective local government. The bailiff shall notify the State Land Service or the local government respectively of the description of the immovable property for securing a claim or debt enforcement. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002 with amendments made by the Laws of 1 December 2005 and 11 December 2008, which enters into force on 31 December 2008.)

5. If on the day this Law enters into force the procedural time limits set in the Latvian Code of Civil Procedure regarding judgment enforcement actions have not expired and this Law sets a longer time limit, the longer time limit shall apply, including the elapsed time.
6. If property has been transferred to a commission until the day this Law enters into force in accordance with Article 390 of the Latvian Code of Civil Procedure, its realisation shall be carried out in accordance with the terms of the commission agreement.
7. If shares of capital or closed issue shares of a commercial company have been transferred to the executive institution of the respective commercial company in accordance with the provisions of the third paragraph of Article 389 of the Latvian Code of Civil Procedure until the day this Law enters into force, the executive institution shall carry out the sale within the specified one-month period from the day of transfer.
8. If an auction of described property belonging to the debtor has been announced until the day this Law enters into force, it shall be held according to the announced terms.
9. If a calculation prepared by a bailiff regarding judgment enforcement expenses has been submitted to the court until the day this Law enters into force, the court shall adopt a decision on the calculation previously prepared by the bailiff.
10. If a bailiff has adopted a decision on suspension of enforcement proceedings, then in cases where suspension of enforcement proceedings is not provided for by the Civil Procedure Law, after this Law enters into force, enforcement proceedings shall be resumed immediately. The bailiff shall adopt a respective decision and send it to the interested persons.
11. With the entry into force of this Law, the Latvian Code of Civil Procedure shall cease to have effect, except for its Chapters Twenty-Two, Twenty-Three, Twenty-Three-A, Twenty-Four, Twenty-Four-A and Twenty-Five.
12. Amendments to the Civil Procedure Law regarding the second paragraph, Points 1 and 2, and the first sentence of the third paragraph of Article 34, Point 8 of Article 39, Point 9 of Article 43, regarding the deletion of Chapters 40, 41, 42, 43, 44 and the second paragraph of Article 566 shall enter into force on 1 January 2012. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002 with amendments made by the Laws of 1 December 2005 and 11 December 2008, which enters into force on 31 December 2008.)

13. Cases on inheritance rights which have been accepted for hearing in special court proceedings until 31 December 2002 shall be heard by the court in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it was in force until 31 December 2011 (the norms referred to in Point 12 of the transitional provisions, which cease to have effect on 31 December 2011). (In the wording of the Law of 4 August 2011, which enters into force on 1 October 2011.)

14. Applications for establishment of guardianship over an estate in inheritance cases in notarial proceedings shall be heard by the court applying Article 323 of this Law and Article 660 of the Civil Law. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002, which enters into force on 1 January 2003.)

15. An application for establishment of an oral will, which is necessary for submission to a notary in an inheritance case, shall be heard by the court in the procedure set out in Article 309 of this Law, inviting heirs as interested persons. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002, which enters into force on 1 January 2003.)

16. Until the establishment of a state fee for the transfer of property to heirs on the basis of a certificate of inheritance issued by a notary, a state fee shall be payable at 50 per cent of the rate set in Article 34 of the Civil Procedure Law in cases on confirmation of inheritance rights or on the entry into legal force of a last will and testament. In the said cases, the established state fee in relation to immovable property shall be collected before the consolidation of ownership rights in the Land Register, but in relation to movable property it shall be paid before the issuance of the certificate of inheritance, and the notary shall make a certification thereof in the certificate of inheritance. Keepers of registers of movable property, as well as persons with whom inherited property is located (credit institutions, etc.), are not entitled to re-register inherited property or issue it to heirs if the property is not indicated in the certificate of inheritance and the state fee has not been paid. (In the wording of the Law of 31 October 2002, which enters into force on 1 January 2003.)

17. Point 2 of the first paragraph of Article 346 of this Law, regarding that a copy of the judge's decision on initiation of insolvency proceedings shall be sent to the Financial and Capital Market Commission, and Paragraph 2.1 of Article 378 shall enter into force by a special law. (In the wording of the Law of 12 February 2004, which enters into force on 10 March 2004.)

18. All applications for recognition and enforcement of foreign court decisions (except foreign arbitral awards) submitted to a district (city) court and not heard until 1 May 2004 shall be heard by the court of first instance in the procedure that was in force before 1 May 2004. At the applicant's request, the judge may decide such applications in the procedure set out in this Law, and the 10-day time limit for deciding the application shall be calculated from the day of submission of the applicant's request. (In the wording of the Law of 7 April 2004, which enters into force on 1 May 2004.)

19. If a district (city) court has adopted a decision on recognition and enforcement of a foreign court decision (except a foreign arbitral award) or a decision on rejection of an application and on 1 May 2004 the time limit for submitting an appeal has not expired, the time limits for submitting an appeal set in the second paragraph of Article 641 of this Law shall apply, including the elapsed time. (In the wording of the Law of 7 April 2004, which enters into force on 1 May 2004.)

20. The new wording of Article 486 of this Law, which sets the procedure for establishing an arbitral tribunal, and Article 486.1 shall enter into force on 1 April 2005. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

21. An arbitral tribunal which has been established and whose establishment has been notified to the Ministry of Justice until 31 March 2005 shall submit an application to the Enterprise Register for registration of the arbitral tribunal no later than 15 August 2005, observing the procedure set out in this Law and other regulatory enactments. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

22. The Ministry of Justice shall publish in the newspaper "Latvijas Vēstnesis" by 20 October 2005 those arbitral tribunals which have not registered in the register of arbitral tribunals by 30 September 2005. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

23. If the parties have agreed to submit a dispute for resolution to a permanent arbitral tribunal and this arbitral tribunal has not registered in the procedure set by law by 30 September 2005 or has ceased its operations, the parties shall agree on submission of the dispute for resolution to another arbitral tribunal. If no agreement is reached, the dispute shall be heard in court. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

24. The name of a newly established arbitral tribunal must clearly and definitely differ from the names of arbitral tribunals in the Ministry of Justice list. Priority for an arbitral tribunal name in the register of arbitral tribunals belongs to the arbitral tribunal which was first entered in the Ministry of Justice list with such a name. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

25. If arbitral proceedings have been commenced until 10 March 2005 in disputes referred to in Points 6 and 7 of Article 487 of this Law (on eviction of a person from living quarters and individual labour law disputes), their resolution shall be completed in the respective arbitral tribunal. (In the wording of the Law of 17 February 2005, which enters into force on 10 March 2005.)

26. Until 30 June 2006, an application for insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies shall be submitted to the respective regional court. Cases on insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies initiated until 30 June 2006 shall be heard by the respective regional court. (In the wording of the Law of 1 December 2005, which enters into force on 31 December 2005.)

27. The new wording of Article 447 of this Law, which sets the hearing of appeals against judges' decisions and decisions of Land Register division judges in written proceedings, shall enter into force on 1 July 2006 and shall apply to the hearing of appeals against those decisions which have been adopted from 1 July 2006. (In the wording of the Law of 25 May 2006, which enters into force on 28 June 2006.)

28. Amendments to the third paragraph of Article 238, the second paragraph of Article 239, the fourth paragraph of Article 246, the first paragraph of Article 250.5, the first paragraph of Article 266, the third paragraph of Article 267, the second paragraph of Article 268, the first and third paragraphs of Article 270, the second paragraph of Article 275, the second paragraph of Article 276, the second paragraph of Article 277, the second paragraph of Article 280, the fourth paragraph of Article 286, Article 323 (regarding deletion of the word "parish court") and the third paragraph of Article 329 (regarding replacement of the word "parish court" with the word "orphan's court") of this Law shall enter into force on 1 January 2007. (In the wording of the Law of 7 September 2006, which enters into force on 11 October 2006.)

29. Cases in which insolvency of an enterprise (commercial company), as well as a merchant registered in the Commercial Register, has been declared until 31 December 2007 shall be heard by the court that declared the insolvency. (In the wording of the Law of 1 November 2007, which enters into force on 1 January 2008.)

30. The new wording of Article 434 of this Law (on the procedure by which a judgment of a court of appeal enters into legal force and is enforceable), Article 439.1, the new wording of Article 464 (on a session of the Supreme Court), as well as Articles 464.1 and 477.1 shall enter into force on 1 July 2008. Judgments of a court of appeal which the court has pronounced until 30 June 2008 shall enter into legal force at the moment of their pronouncement, and enforcement of these judgments of a court of appeal shall be commenced, continued and completed in the procedure set out in Part E of this Law. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008 with amendments made by the Law of 30 October 2014, which enters into force on 1 January 2015.)

31. The actions of the court set by law in connection with the sending of court decisions to the institution authorised by law that makes entries in the insolvency register shall not apply to those court decisions which have been adopted in insolvency cases in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which further issues have been decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

32. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which issues are to be decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007, the appointed administrator shall submit to the court until the hearing of the case or until the time limit set in the judge's decision:

1) a list of persons who are representatives of the debtor according to law;
2) a list of property belonging to third parties and in the possession or holding of the debtor;
3) lists of secured and unsecured creditors prepared on the basis of data in the debtor's accounting;
4) a report on the debtor's monetary funds in bank accounts and cash, the value of the debtor's fixed assets and current assets;
5) an opinion on whether insolvency proceedings set in Point 1 or 2 of Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2015/848 of the European Parliament and of the Council are to be commenced against the debtor. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008 with amendments made by the Law of 31 May 2018, which enters into force on 1 July 2018.)

33. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007, but a judgment on declaration of insolvency is adopted after this date, the court shall determine the representatives of the debtor in the judgment based on the list of the debtor's representatives submitted by the administrator, and shall determine their duties in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

34. The court shall not terminate those insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 when approving a settlement. The court shall adopt a decision on termination of insolvency proceedings in cases of conclusion of a settlement if it establishes that the debtor has settled all its obligations for which the performance time limit has arrived and after settlement of these obligations its assets exceed the remaining debt amount. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

35. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007, the court shall decide on cancellation of a settlement on the basis of a respective application if:

1) when concluding the settlement, requirements of regulatory enactments have been violated;
2) the conclusion of the settlement was achieved by using fraud or coercion, or occurred under the influence of error;
3) the debtor does not fulfil the obligations provided for in the settlement. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

36. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which issues are to be decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007, complaints may be submitted:

1) by the administrator — against any decision of the creditors' meeting and decision of the creditors' committee, as well as against a decision of the Insolvency Control Service regarding the administrator's actions;
2) by an interested creditor or group of creditors — against a decision of the creditors' meeting by which a claim of a creditor has been recognised or rejected, within three weeks from the day of the creditors' meeting or the day the creditor who did not participate in the creditors' meeting was notified of its decision;
3) by a creditor or group of creditors — against a decision of the creditors' meeting (creditors' committee) on administration expenses and the procedure for settling debts within three weeks after its adoption. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008 with amendments made by the Law of 31 May 2018, which enters into force on 1 July 2018.)

37. In insolvency proceedings in which an insolvency application has been submitted to the court until 31 December 2007 and in which further issues are to be decided in court in accordance with the regulatory enactments that regulated the insolvency of enterprises and commercial companies until 31 December 2007, the debtor may submit to the court an application for termination of insolvency proceedings if it has settled all debt obligations within the specified time limits and the value of assets exceeds the remaining debt obligation amount. (In the wording of the Law of 22 May 2008, which enters into force on 25 June 2008.)

38. Orders which have been issued for making deductions until 28 February 2009 in accordance with Article 597 of this Law shall be enforceable in accordance with what is indicated in the respective bailiff's order. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

39. Until the day the Cabinet of Ministers regulations referred to in the second paragraph of Article 39 of this Law enter into force, but no longer than until 1 September 2009, Cabinet of Ministers Regulation No. 154 of 27 April 1999 "Procedure by Which Amounts Payable to Witnesses and Experts and Expenses Related to the Search for the Defendant Are Calculated in Civil Cases" shall apply insofar as they are not in conflict with this Law. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

40. A court that has commenced hearing a civil case until 28 February 2009, the materials of which include a state secret object, shall complete the commenced hearing of the civil case. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

41. Amendments regarding the third paragraph of Article 345 of this Law (on extension of the time limit for approval of the plan of legal protection process measures to 30 days) shall enter into force simultaneously with amendments to the Insolvency Law which provide that the plan of legal protection process measures is simultaneously sent to the administrator and secured creditors for providing an opinion, as well as to unsecured creditors — for approval. (In the wording of the Law of 5 February 2009, which enters into force on 1 March 2009.)

42. Paragraph seven of Article 363.9 of this Law shall not apply to settlements approved in court until 30 June 2009. (In the wording of the Law of 11 June 2009, which enters into force on 1 July 2009.)

43. If an auction of immovable property has been announced until 31 January 2010, it shall be held according to the announced terms. If the announced second auction has not taken place and no one wishes to retain the immovable property for themselves (Article 615), at the creditor's request, after one month from the day of publication of the announcement, the bailiff shall hold a third auction, observing the terms of the first auction, but bidding shall start from an amount corresponding to 60 per cent of the starting price in the first auction. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009, which enters into force on 1 February 2010.)

44. In the period from 1 February 2010 to 31 December 2012, in addition to what is set in the third paragraph of Article 600 of this Law, a mortgage creditor in whose favour a first mortgage has been consolidated, unless it is also the creditor, shall simultaneously be requested to inform the bailiff whether it agrees to the sale of the immovable property, except in cases where enforcement is carried out in favour of such claims:

1) for enforcement of maintenance for a child or parent;
2) for enforcement of wages;
3) for personal injury resulting in mutilation or other health damage or death of a person;
4) for tax and non-tax payments to the budget;
5) for compensation for losses caused to the property of natural persons by a criminal offence or administrative violation;
6) for debt enforcement in favour of an insolvency subject. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009 with amendments made by the Law of 9 June 2011, which enters into force on 18 June 2011.)

45. If a mortgage creditor in whose favour a first mortgage has been consolidated objects to the sale of immovable property (Point 44 of the transitional provisions), the bailiff shall postpone levy of enforcement on the immovable property for one year, but no longer than until 31 December 2012. (In the wording of the Law of 17 December 2009, which enters into force on 1 February 2010.)

46. To legal protection proceedings, out-of-court legal protection proceedings, legal person insolvency proceedings, as well as natural person insolvency proceedings commenced until 31 October 2010, Chapters 46, 46.1 and 46.2 of this Law in the wording that was in force until 31 October 2010 and Point 42 of the transitional provisions shall apply. (In the wording of the Law of 30 September 2010, which enters into force on 1 November 2010.)

47. Cases on dissolution of marriage upon a joint application of both spouses and cases on deposit of the subject of an obligation with the court for safekeeping, which have been accepted for hearing in courts until 31 January 2011, shall be heard in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it was in force until 31 January 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 28 October 2010, which enters into force on 1 February 2011.)

48. An auction of movable property announced until 31 January 2011 shall be held in accordance with the provisions that were in force on the day of announcement of the auction. (In the wording of the Law of 28 October 2010, which enters into force on 1 February 2011.)

49. The new wording of Point 7 of the first paragraph of Article 34 of this Law (which provides for the state fee amount for an application for undisputed compulsory enforcement, for compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure or for voluntary sale of immovable property at auction through the court — 2 per cent of the debt amount or the value of the property to be returned or sold at voluntary auction, but not more than 350 lats) shall enter into force on 1 February 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

50. The new wording of the sixth paragraph of Article 587 of this Law (which provides that a person who has bid for the item being sold shall pay the full amount bid and value added tax if the auction price is subject to value added tax, no later than the next working day after the auction) shall enter into force on 1 February 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

51. In relation to auctions of movable property and immovable property announced until 31 December 2010, those norms of the Civil Procedure Law that were in force until 31 December 2010 shall apply. (In the wording of the Law of 20 December 2010, which enters into force on 1 January 2011.)

52. Point 3 of the first paragraph of Article 133 of this Law, Chapter 30.3, as well as amendments to the first paragraph of Article 37, the second and fourth paragraphs of Article 406.4, the second and third paragraphs of Article 406.6, the second and third paragraphs of Article 406.8, the first and third paragraphs of Article 450 and the fifth paragraph of Article 486 of this Law shall enter into force on 1 October 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

53. The provisions of Chapter 30.3 of this Law shall not apply to the hearing of claim applications received by the court until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

54. State fees paid until 30 September 2011 in cases on compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure shall be refunded in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it was in force until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

55. The amendment to the fifth paragraph of Article 486 of this Law regarding the distinguishability of arbitral tribunal names shall not apply to an arbitral tribunal name entered in the register of arbitral tribunals until 30 September 2011. (In the wording of the Law of 8 September 2011, which enters into force on 30 September 2011.)

56. The second sentence of Article 24 of this Law [on the competence of the Land Register division of a district (city) court in hearing applications for undisputed compulsory enforcement and compulsory enforcement of obligations in warning procedure] and the third paragraph of Article 566, as well as the amendment providing for deletion of the introductory part of the second paragraph of Article 34, and amendments to Article 403 and the second paragraph of Article 406.2 [on submission of applications to the Land Register division of a district (city) court] shall enter into force on 1 January 2012. (In the wording of the Law of 4 August 2011, which enters into force on 1 October 2011.)

57. An administrator whom the court has removed from performance of his or her duties by decision in the period from 1 November 2010 to 1 July 2012 on the basis of Point 7 of the second paragraph of Article 22 of the Insolvency Law may appeal this court decision in the procedure set out in the seventh paragraph of Article 341.8, the twelfth paragraph of Article 363.14 or the ninth paragraph of Article 363.28 of this Law until 11 July 2012. A decision of a regional court is not grounds for reinstatement of the administrator in the insolvency proceedings or legal protection proceedings from which he or she was removed. (In the wording of the Law of 21 June 2012, which enters into force on 1 July 2012.)

58. (Deleted by the Law of 19 December 2013, which enters into force on 4 January 2014.)

59. If the court has established temporary guardianship based on Point 1 of Article 21 of the Law "On the Time and Procedure for Entry into Force of the Family Law Part of the Restored Civil Law of the Republic of Latvia of 1937" and within one month after the day these amendments enter into force an application for restriction of a person's legal capacity and establishment of guardianship has not been submitted, the judge shall adopt a decision on termination of temporary guardianship. The decision on termination of temporary guardianship shall be sent to the orphan's court for enforcement, to the prosecutor, the guardian and the person whose legal capacity has been restricted. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012, which enters into force on 1 January 2013.)

60. If the court has suspended proceedings based on Points 2 and 3 of Article 21 of the Law "On the Time and Procedure for Entry into Force of the Family Law Part of the Restored Civil Law of the Republic of Latvia of 1937", it shall resume proceedings on its own initiative, upon an application by a party to the case or the guardian. If a person who is the applicant in the suspended case has lost the right to bring an action in cases on establishment of guardianship or review of restriction of legal capacity in accordance with amendments to the Civil Law and Civil Procedure Law which entered into force on 1 January 2013, the court shall notify the prosecutor's office thereof and the prosecutor shall take the place of the applicant. When resuming proceedings, the court shall explain to the applicant his or her rights to amend the subject and grounds of the application. Such cases shall be heard in court in the procedure set out in the Civil Procedure Law as it is in force from the day these amendments enter into force. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012 with amendments made by the Law of 23 May 2013, which enters into force on 1 November 2013.)

61. A person whom the court has recognised as legally incapable until 31 December 2011 due to mental illness or insanity and has established guardianship due to its wasteful or extravagant life, as well as due to use of alcohol or other intoxicating substances, shall henceforth be considered a person with restriction of legal capacity without restriction of personal non-property rights. Until the respective amendments to other regulatory enactments enter into force, the legal regulation regarding a legally incapable person and a person for whom guardianship has been established due to its wasteful or extravagant life, as well as due to use of alcohol or other intoxicating substances, shall be interpreted and applied in accordance with what is set in this Law and the Civil Law. (In the wording of the Law of 29 November 2012, which enters into force on 1 January 2013.)

62. The legal incapacity of the person referred to in Point 61 of these transitional provisions shall be reviewed according to the same provisions as for a person with restriction of legal capacity. The guardian has a duty to submit to the court an application for review of restriction of legal capacity regarding the person referred to in Point 61 of these transitional provisions within four years after these amendments enter into force, if an application for review of restriction of legal capacity has not been submitted to the court or a judgment regarding it has not entered into force. If after the said time limit an application for review of a person's restriction of legal capacity has not been submitted to the court or a judgment regarding it has not entered into force, the orphan's court shall inform the prosecutor's office within one year from expiry of the time limit for the duty imposed on the guardian of such legally incapable persons for whom it is necessary to review the restriction of legal capacity.

context: s par personas rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu vai attiecībā uz to nav stājies spēkā spriedums, bāriņtiesa gada laikā no iepriekš minētā aizgādnim uzliktā pienākuma termiņa notecējuma informē prokuratūru par tādām rīcībnespējīgām personām, kurām nepieciešams pārskatīt rīcībspējas ierobežojumu.
text:
Tiesa informē Iedzīvotāju reģistru, ka ir saņēmusi pieteikumu par rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu rīcībnespējīgai personai, kurš iesniegts pēc četriem gadiem no dienas, kad stājās spēkā attiecīgie grozījumi. Iedzīvotāju reģistrs informē prokuratūru, kurai personai pēc četriem gadiem no dienas, kad stājās spēkā šie grozījumi, nav stājies spēkā spriedums par rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu un kurai šo pārejas noteikumu 61.punktā minētajai personai tiesā ir ierosināta rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšana. Prokuratūra iesniedz pieteikumu tiesā par minētās personas rīcībspējas ierobežojuma pārskatīšanu septiņu gadu laikā no šo grozījumu spēkā stāšanās dienas. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

63. Līdz šā likuma 483.panta grozījumu spēkā stāšanās dienai attiecīgajai amatpersonai iesniegtā sūdzība izskatāma saskaņā ar tiem noteikumiem, kādi bija spēkā sūdzības iesniegšanas dienā. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

64. Šā likuma 11.panta pirmās daļas 4.2 punktā, 251.panta 3.1 punktā un 34.1 nodaļā "Nākotnes pilnvarnieka tiesību apturēšana" izdarītie grozījumi saistībā ar nākotnes pilnvarojumu stājas spēkā vienlaikus ar Civillikuma ceturtās daļas 18.nodaļas pirmās apakšnodaļas III1 sadaļu "Nākotnes pilnvarojums". (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013. Sk. 29.11.2012. likumu)

65. Šķīrējtiesu reģistrā reģistrētas pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas dibinātājs līdz 2013.gada 1.aprīlim iesniedz Uzņēmumu reģistram apliecinājumu, ka šķīrējtiesnesis atbilst šā likuma 497.panta otrās daļas prasībām, pievienojot dokumentus, kas pamato šķīrējtiesneša kvalifikāciju. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

66. Ja puses ir vienojušās par strīda nodošanu pastāvīgajā šķīrējtiesā un šīs šķīrējtiesas dibinātājs normatīvajos aktos noteiktajā kārtībā līdz 2013.gada 1.aprīlim nav iesniedzis apliecinājumu par pastāvīgajā šķīrējtiesā esošā šķīrējtiesneša atbilstību šā likuma 497.panta otrās daļas prasībām, puses vienojas par strīda nodošanu izšķiršanai citai šķīrējtiesai. Ja vienošanās netiek panākta, strīds izskatāms tiesā. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

67. Šķīrējtiesnesis, kurš neatbilst šā likuma 497.panta otrās daļas prasībām, līdz šo grozījumu spēkā stāšanās brīdim uzsākto šķīrējtiesas procesu pabeidz attiecīgajā šķīrējtiesā. (29.11.2012. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2013.)

68. Šā likuma 30.4 nodaļas noteikumi nav piemērojami to prasības pieteikumu izskatīšanai, kuri saņemti tiesā līdz 2013.gada 30.jūnijam. (18.04.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 22.05.2013.)

69. Grozījums šā likuma 400.pantā par tā papildināšanu ar 1.1 daļu, kas paredz, ka panta pirmā daļa nav piemērojama Notariāta likuma D1 sadaļā noteiktajā kārtībā taisītiem notariālajiem aktiem, attiecas uz tiem notariālajiem aktiem, kuri taisīti pēc 2013.gada 31.oktobra. (23.05.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2013.)

70. Lietas par saistību bezstrīdus piespiedu izpildīšanu, pamatojoties uz saistībām, saskaņā ar kurām līdz 2013.gada 31.oktobrim bija pieļaujama bezstrīdus piespiedu izpildīšana, izskata šajā likumā noteiktajā kārtībā, kāda bija spēkā līdz 2013.gada 31.oktobrim. (23.05.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2013.)

71. Šā likuma 539.panta otrās daļas 5.punkts un 540.panta 15.punkts attiecas uz tiem notariālajiem aktiem, kuri taisīti pēc 2013.gada 31.oktobra. (23.05.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2013.)

72. Grozījumi šā likuma 551.panta pirmajā daļā un 594.panta pirmajā un otrajā daļā, kuri paredz, ka parādniekam saglabājama darba samaksa un tai pielīdzinātie maksājumi ne mazāk kā minimālās mēneša darba algas apmērā un uz katru apgādībā esošo nepilngadīgo bērnu līdzekļi valsts sociālā nodrošinājuma pabalsta apmērā, stājas spēkā 2014.gada 1.janvārī. Izpildu lietās, kuras zvērināta tiesu izpildītāja lietvedībā ievestas un nav pabeigtas līdz šā likuma 594.panta pirmās un otrās daļas grozījumu spēkā stāšanās brīdim un kurās tiek piemērots piespiedu izpildes līdzeklis
— piedziņas vēršana uz parādniekam izmaksājamo darba samaksu vai tai pielīdzinātajiem maksājumiem —, šā likuma 594.panta pirmajā un otrajā daļā noteikto parādniekam saglabājamo līdzekļu apmēru laika posmā no šā likuma 594.panta pirmajā un otrajā daļā minēto grozījumu spēkā stāšanās un līdz brīdim, kad zvērināta tiesu izpildītāja rīkojumā norādītā piedzenamā parāda summa ir dzēsta vai piemērotais piespiedu izpildes līdzeklis atcelts, aprēķina darba devējs vai attiecīgā juridiskā persona brīdī, kad izdara ieturējumu no parādnieka darba samaksas vai tai pielīdzinātajiem maksājumiem. (23.05.2013. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 19.12.2013. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 04.01.2014.)

73. (Izslēgts ar 10.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 31.12.2020.)

74. Grozījumi šā likuma 250.27 pantā par tiesas spriedumu, kas taisīti lietās par maza apmēra prasībām, pārsūdzēšanu apelācijas kārtībā stājas spēkā 2014.gada 1.aprīlī. (19.12.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 04.01.2014.)

75. Grozījumi šā likuma 250.27 pantā par tiesas spriedumu, kas taisīti lietās par maza apmēra prasībām, pārsūdzēšanu apelācijas kārtībā attiecas uz spriedumiem, kas pasludināti vai — ja spriedumi taisīti rakstveida procesā — sastādīti pēc 2014.gada 1.aprīļa. (19.12.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 04.01.2014.)

76. Šā likuma 406.3 panta otrās daļas 10.punkta noteikumi par apliecinājuma ietveršanu pieteikumā nav piemērojami to pieteikumu izskatīšanai, kuri iesniegti tiesai līdz 2014.gada 1.jūlijam. (19.12.2013. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 04.01.2014.)

77. Šķīrējtiesu reģistrā reģistrētas pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas dibinātājs līdz 2014.gada 15.jūlijam iesniedz Uzņēmumu reģistram reglamenta grozījumus atbilstoši grozījumiem šā likuma 486.1 pantā. (22.05.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 05.06.2014.)

78. Ja šķīrējtiesu reģistrā reģistrētas pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas dibinātājs šo pārejas noteikumu 77.punktā noteiktajā termiņā nav iesniedzis Uzņēmumu reģistram minētos dokumentus, Uzņēmumu reģistrs līdz 2014.gada 15.septembrim saskaņā ar Ministru kabineta 2005.gada 29.marta noteikumiem Nr.204 " Noteikumi par šķīrējtiesu reģistru" lemj par pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas izslēgšanu no šķīrējtiesu reģistra. (22.05.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 05.06.2014.)

79. Ja puses vienojušās par civiltiesiskā strīda nodošanu izšķiršanai pastāvīgajā šķīrējtiesā, kura saskaņā ar šo pārejas noteikumu 78.punktu ir izslēgta no pastāvīgo šķīrējtiesu reģistra, puses vienojas par civiltiesiskā strīda nodošanu izšķiršanai citā šķīrējtiesā. Ja vienošanās netiek panākta, strīds izskatāms rajona (pilsētas) tiesā. (22.05.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 05.06.2014.)

80. Pastāvīgā šķīrējtiesa, kura saskaņā ar šo pārejas noteikumu 78.punktu ir izslēgta no pastāvīgo šķīrējtiesu reģistra, var pabeigt uzsākto lietu izskatīšanu, bet ne ilgāk kā līdz 2014.gada 31.decembrim. (22.05.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 05.06.2014.)

81. No šķīrējtiesu reģistra izslēgtās pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas dibinātājs līdz 2014.gada 1.oktobrim nodod procesuālos dokumentus glabāšanā Latvijas Nacionālajam arhīvam, sedzot izdevumus par procesuālo dokumentu glabāšanu. (22.05.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 05.06.2014.)

82. Pieteikumu par pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas sprieduma piespiedu izpildi vai par atteikumu izdot izpildu rakstu pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas sprieduma piespiedu izpildei, kurš saņemts līdz 2014.gada 31.decembrim, tiesa izskata tādā kārtībā, kāda bija spēkā pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas sprieduma taisīšanas brīdī. (11.09.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2014.)

83. Grozījumi šā likuma D daļā par pastāvīgās šķīrējtiesas sprieduma izpildes kārtību un par 61., 62., 63., 64. un
65.nodaļas izslēgšanu stājas spēkā 2015.gada 1.janvārī. (11.09.2014. likuma redakcijā, kas stājas spēkā 01.11.2014.)

84. Šā likuma 611.panta trešo daļu par pieteikuma par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz ieguvēja vārda elektronisku iesniegšanu, šā likuma 613.panta trešo daļu par ieskatīšanos Izpildu lietu reģistrā un šā likuma 615.panta piekto daļu par pieteikuma par nekustamā īpašuma nostiprināšanu uz nosolītāja, līdzīpašnieka vai kreditora vārda un par zemesgrāmatā ierakstīto parādu dzēšanas elektronisku iesniegšanu sāk piemērot līdz ar attiecīgā tehniskā nodrošinājuma pieejamību, bet ne vēlāk kā ar 2015.gada 1.janvāri.
